reviews.title: OK, for Mowry And Cotton
reviews.text:
Nice outdoor dining looking out to the pool.  The wines were fine and we ordered off the outdoor menu.  The Pork Tacos were good, just could have used a few more of the small size tortillas.

My husband and I were not keen on all of the birds that would pick up food off the ground near or on the tables if they weren't quickly cleared.  And there was also a gentleman who was going from table to table to show his hawk on his arm that too, flew out periodically and came back to his arm. We most likely would not go back.
reviews.author: D i

reviews.title: Front Desk Service
reviews.text:
The food, atmosphere, and location made the visit very pleasurable. 

If the service at the front desk was equal to the above items, I would give the restaurant 5 stars. 

Everyone who puts their name down gets a 15-20 minute wait, even when they're slow. Further, I put my name down, and guests who came after me were seated first. As soon as I notified the front desk, they called my name. 

It seems the manager is unaware or careless about the impression guests receive upon being greeted by the front desk. 

So, 3 stars because of the great food, environment, etc., and because of the pompousness with which many guests are given, as if they're begging for food. 

There are other breakfast locations in Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Roy A

reviews.title: Lunch at Mowry And Cotton
reviews.text: Lovely sunny afternoon eating lunch at the patio restaurant. Nice, limited menu with excellent service. No wait time and the location is stunning. Good value for the various food options.
reviews.author: Marisa

reviews.title: Customer 4 life
reviews.text:
Amazing! Flavorful. Kudos to Chef....
Staff is friendly, knowledgeable and on point. 
12 out of 10 for me.....
Julzz
reviews.author: Julia h

reviews.title: Enjoyed before enjoyed Thanksgiving too!
reviews.text: Excellent food and atmosphere! We enjoyed their Thanksgiving feast and would do it again! Early dinner allowed for nice patio seating ingredients with gorgeous views and stunning sunset! Food was excellent, one our top choices!
reviews.author: John B

reviews.title: John's drinks are excellent, but some areas for improvement
reviews.text:
We've been there several times and had a variety of experiences. This time, we went to the bar area for the first time with my husband and his son. John's drinks are excellent, and the service was very good. I liked the soup, although the bar menu wasn't very extensive. The place was practically empty; I like the decor and the music. There was a relaxed, casual atmosphere that day.
What I didn't like: I was freezing the whole time I was there. I ordered coffee, which came out cold. The smell in the bathroom made me think I'd entered the kitchen.
reviews.author: LifestylebyMaite

reviews.title: Weekend Getaway
reviews.text: We were in The pool at Phoenician when we over heard the person bringing the cocktails that Mowery and Cotton was a place for foodies. It truly was. Our server Hector was absolutely fantastic. He was funny , honest and very knowledgeable about the wine and food. He brought a beautiful glass of wine. We decided on the heritage chicken but weren’t sure which sides. He guided us to the crunchy potatoes and Brussels sprouts. What a fantastic pairing. The food was incredibly creative and delicious. Hector was amazing through the whole meal. He is very personable and extremely good at his job. I will be coming to Mowery and Cotton for my birthday this year. The experience was that good. Thank you Hector and team.
reviews.author: Barbara B

reviews.title: Fantastic dinner at the Phoenician!
reviews.text: The lobster gnocchi dish was truly tremendous. The lobster was a tail and the gnocchi set it up perfectly.  Also, the mushroom flatbread was excellent. The best, however, was the service by Christian, professional and caring. He made sure the meal was a wonderful event.
reviews.author: Dan B

reviews.title: Pleasant dinner
reviews.text: We enjoyed our meal here sitting outside.  Nice server.  Good menu and we were able to share the meal as the portions are large.  Nice buttermilk roll - easily enough for 4 people.  The flatbreads were big enough to have as a meal.
reviews.author: LAW64

reviews.title: Bar is great, other service is slow
reviews.text: Great drinks made by the wonderful Lexi. She is the shining star of Mowry & Cotton!!!  She is very friendly and makes amazing cocktails. The waitstaff, especially for breakfast is extremely slow. One morning we even thought we were forgotten about. I highly recommend eating and drinking in the bar for the best service.
reviews.author: Kapanda

reviews.title: Impeccable Staff & Dinner
reviews.text: Came here one night when we didn't feel like leaving the property for dinner. They offered us a lovely seat around a fire pit. The waiter Raul was EXCELLENT - even offering us cocktail options that were not on the menu. I was looking for something citrusy with tequila, and he concocted a drink that really fit the bill. My cousin was wanted a filet for dinner and was originally told that they were out. A few minutes later he returned stating that he worked something out with the chef - not sure what, but really good service on his part. The lamb pappardelle was also delicious. Not sure if I would have made a point to come here if I wasn't staying on site, but definitely an excellent option for hotel guests.
reviews.author: AustintoBoston

reviews.title: Disapointing luncn
reviews.text: Big place in a resort.   Our service was good, but the food was average at best.   So disapointed with the Brisket sandwich.   So little brisqet to bread ration, they really missed the mark.   What I tasted was good by itself, but not enough brisket.   Salads were good and service good.   Unless I was staying here, I would not go our of my way to eat here.   Reviews are over-rated.
reviews.author: lost_bobcat

reviews.title: Descent Food, not for the Budget-minded
reviews.text:
Didn't realize this place was in a golf/spa resort until we arrived.  Not clearly marked, so had to ask the front desk for location.
Limited menu.  I ordered the basic 2-egg breakfast over medium, and was excited for the chimichurri breakfast potatoes.
I was a bit disappointed.  The eggs were ALMOST perfect, but, still had that runny white (ick), and the potatoes were fingerling...and JUST done, which made them NOT fork tender.  The flavor was only on the outside and barely there.  BUT, what saved the day was the bacon....perfection!!!
My husband had the bagel and lox, and he said it was amazing. Very good.
We ordered the avocado toast to share, cause I thought it was only $6.50...oops, that was only if you wanted to add an egg 😳....didn't realize that until paying bill. Was good, but, I didn't care for the after taste of the multi-grain bread they used.
All-in-all, food was descent, but, for the $100 price, you can find meals just as good elsewhere.
reviews.author: clslape

reviews.title: Sunday Brunch
reviews.text:
Awesome food and service from Jordan. Very patient and attention to detail.
Food was superb and fresh and wonderful service.
reviews.author: Katy B

reviews.title: Breakfast in Scottsdale, AZ
reviews.text:
Dined here twice for breakfast since we had free breakfast (up to $80) as our perk, just had to be here before 11am.  Both times, we (party of 3) were seated right away.

Food was delicious—downside is that the menu doesn’t change, so it was the exact same menu as the day before.  HIGHLY RECOMMEND the Breakfast B.L.T., Avocado Toast and Huevos Rancheros!  The Smoked Salmon & Bagel was great too.  All delicious and tasty, and the portions are generous.

During our first visit, our lady server wasn’t the friendliest which left a bit of a sour experience.  On our second visit, the next day, we got Christine who was beyond AMAZING!!  Super friendly and attentive—Christine even went out of her way to get us Pina Coladas by the pool since the restaurant bar didn’t make them—truly grateful for her kind gesture.  I would definitely request for her!
reviews.author: Vy H.

reviews.title: Maybe I would go back but I'm sure there are better places in the city.
reviews.text: We went with my mom to celebrate her visit to the city from Argentina. The restaurant was reopening after being renovated and we wanted to try this restaurant since I already know the other ones at The Phoenician. Everyone treated us very well from the moment we entered, and the staff outside the building as well. I liked the place, comfortable and good music. There was a mix up with the food and ours took a while to arrive (which didn't bother us) but when it arrived it was cold. Everything was very delicious. I had the scallops and my mom had crab. We didn't see a dessert menu. The waitress offered us only two options, then she reminded us of another one. So we don't know if they have a good dessert menu or not. We each ordered a dessert. I had the chocolate cake which was good (original but nothing out of this world, I didn't finish it) and my mom had two flavors of gelato. The waitress walked 10 steps to load the desserts into the system and I called her again to ask for a glass of sparkling wine and she said no, they had already closed the bar. After she charged us and never showed up for us to tip her. We left the tip on the table and left because we got tired of waiting for her while other employees cleaned tables. Our reservation was for 7:30 and we felt kicked out of the place. Open Table offers tables until much later, I'm glad I didn't book later or I would have only had a glass of wine. We thought that due to the reputation, The Phoenician would pay attention to details since they recently reopened.
reviews.author: LifestylebyMaite

reviews.title: Good food & friendly service at the Phoenican
reviews.text:
Pretty good restaurant.  Good food & friendly service. Nice outdoor seating. 
Recommend eating here if you are at the Phoenician. 

The food & service is much better than J & G Steakhouse.
reviews.author: HowTraveler

reviews.title: A Fine Restaurant In A Great Setting.
reviews.text: Physically encapsulated in the lux profile of the Phoenician resort is the Mowry & Cotton. M & C brings Southwestern indigenous-inspired flavors to their modern American menu. The food catalog is extensive with thoughtful dishes as beautiful as they are delicious. The decor is stunning.........where you can eat inside or dine al fresco with views of the spectacular Phoenician pools. The cuisine is springled with items like Veal & Black Garlic Meatballs, Scottish Salmon, Cowboy Ribeye, Crab Bowtie and others. I fueled my appetite with Corn Soup, Sea Scallops and a sweet burst with a Lemon Tart. A fine restaurant in a great setting.
reviews.author: Conny Wylie

reviews.title: Extensive Menu Featuring Thoughtfully Created & Tasty Dishes.
reviews.text: Mowry & Cotton finds itself in the award-winning luxe style of the Phoenician Resort in Scottsdale. The dining room has a modern-meets-cowboy aura with a classy feel and a patio that has spectacular views of the resort's pool. This eatery serves all day parts as well as a brunch on weekends with a live DJ. It offers seasonal American fare with a wide range of beer, wine & cocktails. The star studded menu reveals delicacies such as: Mowry chopped salad, Veal Meatballs, Pork Tomahawk Steak and the like. I relished my meal collage of Parsnip Coconut Soup, Signature Seafood Dish (Bass), Lemon Tart all washed down with a Sunlight & Shadow cocktail (with Hendrick Gin). The Mowry & Cotton offers an extensive menu featuring thoughtfully created & tasty  dishes.
reviews.author: Conny Wylie

reviews.title: Incredible views, food, and service
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician and went to Cotton & Mowry to celebrate my husbands birthday. We brought my 10 month old son and it was such a nice experience! We had a beautiful view out on the patio, and the food was spectacular. The scallops literally melted in my mouth and my husband’s burger was the juiciest I’ve ever tasted! 10/10 for sure!
reviews.author: Christiana D

reviews.title: Mixology class with Raul.
reviews.text: We did a mixology class with Raul and it was a highlight of our stay. He was personable and informative. I would highly recommend him!
reviews.author: Armando H

reviews.title: Great selections
reviews.text: Located in the Phoenician Resort, we chose to sit outside overlooking the pool area. All the food and drinks were very good, but the highlight was the pork “steak” (this ain’t our Midwest porksteak!); it was exceptional.
reviews.author: Nettie2010

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: This was a solo dinner for me. The ambiance is lovely. I enjoyed two apps—the veal meatballs and shishito peppers. Waitstaff was attentive and professional.  A must not miss when in Scottsdale!
reviews.author: uncg_nurse

reviews.title: Scottsdale’s best dining.
reviews.text: We had such a lovely dining experience as a group. The ambiance felt special for our big family get together. Christine attended to us as our waitress. She was knowledgeable about the menu and saw to every detail. We felt welcome and not rushed. We had an excellent dining experience. I highly recommend the food and the service. We were a group of  10 with varying pallets. Everyone found something on the menu that they were pleased with.
reviews.author: Judy H

reviews.title: Slice of Heaven!!!
reviews.text: Don’t miss out on this slice of heaven! Had the best lunch with family and had the most lovely experience due to our amazing waitress Christine. She provided top notch service, was very knowledgeable and went above and beyond to make our lunch an enjoyable one! Christine is the BEST! We will be back again!
reviews.author: Meagan W

reviews.title: Fabulous Brunch Experience
reviews.text: My family celebrated my parent’s 50th Anniversary by having Brunch at Mowry and Cotton.  Christine was our waitress and she was OUTSTANDING.  She was informative, prompt, and made sure my parents felt very special!
reviews.author: Brett H

reviews.text: Everything was great and the service was fantastic! Everything from this restaurant is 10/10 from the food to the staff.
reviews.author: Bradley O

reviews.title: The perfect dining experience!
reviews.text:
Amazing, amazing, amazing!!! My family and are were in Scottsdale on vacation and ended up dining at Mowry and Cotton TWICE for dinner. We are huge foodies and NEVER eat at the same place more than once while traveling. This place was so delicious, the atmosphere was just perfect, the service was top notch, and the attention to detail is superior. Our waiter was Adam and he completed the experience for us-he was so pleasant and personable that we wanted him to have dinner with us. Mowry and Cotton has a gem with Adam!!!
Just go! It's a must on your next visit to Scottsdale!!!
reviews.author: Lorie A

reviews.title: Amazing and felt right at home
reviews.text: Such a wonderful experience here and Christine our server was amazing looking forward to coming back here! Thank you for everything!
reviews.author: Aggie

reviews.title: 牛排，沙拉都超好吃
reviews.text: 會在飯店裡面的餐廳，他們的主餐沙拉和服務都非常好，我點了他們一個牛排，我建議5分熟，牛排會很嫩，他們的麵包也超嫩超好吃的.
reviews.author: CX

reviews.title: Breakfast with the family in Arizona Day 1
reviews.text: Views, food and staff were amazing! My kids had a great time and the sun was hot ☀️ we had a couple iced vanilla lattes. Certainly a place we’d visit again 🤙
reviews.author: Eric C

reviews.title: Delightful, stress-free dining at Mowery and Cotton at The Phoenician Hotel
reviews.text:
Our waiter, Hector, was fabulous. I love joking around much of the time and Hector chimed right in. Kept laughter in our conversations. 
A welcomed change vs. the usual waiters who simply agree to agree but not give the entertaining challenge…  Anybody fortunate enough to have Hector as a waiter will be delighted with their meal and the time they spent at this restaurant.
reviews.author: Stuart S

reviews.title: Christine is the Reigning Jewel of this place
reviews.text: The Phoenician on the whole provides amazing service and, to be sure, Mowry and Cotton was no exception.  What made this restaurant one that I wanted to keep coming back to was the spectacular, personable, above and beyond service provided by Christine.  Christine was friendly and engaging. She listened and remembered.  She greeted you with a bright smile each and every time she saw you and it felt like you were meeting up with family.  She is truly the Reigning Jewel of this establishment.
reviews.author: LIVING LIFE

reviews.title: Great food, great service
reviews.text: We just ate breakfast here, but what a great way to start our day. The staff was so friendly and attentive. One of the highlights of our stay on property. We had both the continental breakfast and a regular one with eggs and both were fantastic!
reviews.author: AroundTheWorld

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Awesome 👌 service great food!  Had the best service from Adam our server. It was a great experience!
reviews.author: Coastal17185659055

reviews.title: Best of the best
reviews.text: Everything was nothing short of amazing. The service was top tier and will be referring friends and returning with family.
reviews.author: Dorian F

reviews.title: Most amazing service!
reviews.text: We have been to this restaurant numerous times and service has always been great but it’s always taken to another level when we have Christine as our server! She is incredible and one of the most caring, genuine and thoughtful people. Her service is impeccable and always goes off without a hitch. She goes above and beyond to make sure EVERYONE is left feeling satisfied and happy! Thank you Christine for always being the absolute best!!!  ( this is why we keep returning!! Lol)
reviews.author: Nicole M

reviews.title: Breakfast with the Misses
reviews.text: Phil here again, me and the Misses had breakfast at Mowry & Cotton. I recommend you order the Local Citrus for starters. Delicious fresh fruit sourced locally. The Bloody Mary was fantastic and the food was great. I had the huevos rancheros. And the Misses had the Brioche French Toast. I recommend you sit outside, but be careful of the birds flying around you.  Harmless but if you hate birds ask to sit inside.the coolest part is the guy walking around with the Falcon scaring them away.
reviews.author: Phil Clarkston

reviews.title: An amazing experience
reviews.text: We enjoyed the company of fellow conference attendees over an amazing dinner.  Our server was attentive and incredibly knowledgeable.  We had a table of 8.  The homemade buns, deviled eggs, and cheesy bread were top notch.  I had the ribs and potatoes.  Others had the rib eye and corn soup.  The corn soup was like nothing we'd tasted before.  Dessert was the most amazing s'mores and banana combination. It will be hard to forget this meal.
reviews.author: Naders1977

reviews.title: Unique delicious food
reviews.text: Excellent personal service and unique flavorful dishes. Lovely setting outside. Enjoy our dinner very much
reviews.author: Discover00358711217

reviews.title: Great meal and Great service.
reviews.text: Visited for restaurant week. Also had the buttermilk buns which were amazing.  Defiantly worth the visit
reviews.author: Tamara B

reviews.title: Mowry and Cotton Breakfast
reviews.text: Christine was so warm and made this day memorable. She truly cared about making sure we received great service throughout our entire time.
reviews.author: Aiyana M

reviews.title: Experience turned around from a disappointment to over the top rave review!
reviews.text: We are staying at the Phoenician for 4 nights to celebrate our daughter’s graduation from her Masters program at ASU.  The customer experience here has been mostly exceptional - the staff has been attentive and personable.  After requesting an outside table but being told that no tables were available (when nearly all were empty), we went with the flow but mentioned it to our server Christine.  She recovered the guest experience like a true pro - relocating us outside and tending to our every need.  Even bringing a special dessert to celebrate our daughter’s graduation.  As a teacher in PHX schools and soon to be administrator, she was over the moon to be taken care of the way Christine did.  Still with more than half the tables vacant when we left - which would have been quite irritating, but Christine did the right thing and made sure we were well served!  Thanks Christine!
reviews.author: Cheryl R

reviews.title: Fabulous lunch
reviews.text: We were here for a business trip and wanted to try check out the grounds at the Phoenician, we decided to stop and have lunch. Great view of the pool are and I was so excited because they had a Falconer walking around with his Falcon. He stops and talks to you and educates you. I had the Crispy chicken sandwich with red Sangria, it across the board delicious. Very relaxing environment, I could have spent all day there.
reviews.author: lisa h

reviews.title: Pleasant service.  Good appetizers.  Try deviled eggs.
reviews.text: Sat on patio overlooking pool.  Very nice and funny server.  Made our time enjoyable.  Deviled eggs were unusual and delicious.  Flatbread was good too. Inside of restaurant looked beautiful.  Nice experience
reviews.author: Margo

reviews.text: Christine, our server, was amazing! She was kind and thoughtful- even gave us a bag of snacks for our drive out. The breakfast was perfect, the best pancakes we’ve ever had! Beautiful weather and great ambiance! 10/10! Would absolutely recommend ❤️
reviews.author: Trip47953987536

reviews.title: Restaurant falls short
reviews.text:
Famous rolls came cold 3 times.
The peppers were good but sweet. Being a diabetic was concerned.  
Fermented caramel sauce. Sugar and water. Not listed on menu. 
Wine never delivered with meal 
  Very sad service and experience
Better restaurants in area.
reviews.author: Melanie L

reviews.title: A nice place for breakfast and lunch
reviews.text: Sitting outside on the restaurant patio with a great view of the pool and Camelback Mountain in the open Arizona air is great. It also has good food for breakfast and lunch at reasonable prices, with good service.
reviews.author: Tal_Hameed

reviews.title: Average at best
reviews.text: Beautiful restaurant within Phoenician hotel, but mediocre food and average service.    Convenient if staying at resort, but over-priced for quality of food & dining experience.  Dinner food was good, but breakfast was disappointing and well below what a nice resort should execute
reviews.author: Michael T

reviews.title: Loving Mowry
reviews.text:
New to Scottsdale for a year now and while the number of places to eat is staggering,  Mowry and Cotton remains to be one of our top 5.   Dinner twice last week. Caesar salad is a favorite along with either the salmon or the flatbreads.  Everything is beautifully prepared. The setting near the pool is fabulous.  Comfortable chairs.  
*** I want to add, service is just as important to us and the main reason we come back to Mowry so often.  We love Angelica in the mornings.  For dinners it’s both Hector and Christian.   We can bring friends or relatives and know we’ll be treated very well.
reviews.author: kennyS

reviews.title: Top notch in every way
reviews.text: Outstanding location, menu and service.  In the Phoenician resort.  Free valet parking...just tip when leaving.
reviews.author: dwlit

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Wonderful experience start to finish - excellent food and service and view. Christine is the sweetest and so glad we got a chance to meet her. The team is awesome and we look forward to coming back for more meals. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Gregory C

reviews.title: Great breakfast for locals
reviews.text:
We eat out for breakfast daily and are lucky to have Mowry & Cotton so close to home.  Setting is fabulous.  The BLT sandwich is a home run.   Often shared with either yogurt or oatmeal one can’t go wrong.  Big fans of their Fonté coffee too.  
Kudos to Natalia as the host and Angelica as our favorite waiter.  These two go above and beyond.  They are the reason we keep coming back.
reviews.author: kennyS

reviews.title: Mowry & Cotton offers deliciousness
reviews.text: The breakfast was simply scrumptious at Mowry & Cotton. My favorite was the Hand Braided French Toast!!! With breakfast food this good served along with coffee, tea, or a mimosa... you'll want to try more and more from themenu! Love the balcony views from the restaurant and the staff was very helpful!

reviews.title: Wonderful experience
reviews.text: Good food excellent service!  Christine Lam went above and beyond and made our dining experience one of the best at the Phoenician. Would definitely recommend for friends and family.

reviews.title: Amazing experience with Christine Lam!
reviews.text: We had breakfast at Mowry and Cohon for brunch buffet, food is delicious, great for kids and family hangout. Our services Christine Lam is extremely nice and friendly, treated us great! She is amazing severed us and kids, with all the request, we feel like home and so welcomed.  Definitely recommended for everyone come to stay and eat here! Thanks a lot to Christine Lam for our experience!

reviews.title: A little business and a lot of fun
reviews.text: We had such a wonderful evening for my birthday with great service. The steak was cooked to perfection and the drinks arrived on time. 5 stars overall!
reviews.author: Katy B

reviews.title: So Worth it!
reviews.text: Excellent food and service! All 5 of us had something different and everyone loved their food. Our waiter,Adam, was just the best! Worked very hard to give us a wonderful dining experience. Sat outside on a chilly night with the heaters-just perfect.
reviews.author: DallasCouple1

reviews.title: Nice Place
reviews.text:
Service a tad lackadaisical.  Upscale with pricing in parallel.

One steak had to be sent back.

Found an $18 charge for bread.

They automatically added a 20% gratuity to the bill.  Maybe that accounts for the somewhat mediocre service.

Quiet with accommodations to separate our party.
reviews.author: William D

reviews.title: Christine Lam 15/10, 100 stars!
reviews.text:
Last month we dined here while staying at this absolutely incredible resort & somehow our server, Christine Lam, made it even MORE special! She was wonderful - not just with prompt, friendly & accurate service, but with very special touches that made us feel so welcomed & cared for. For instance, when I mentioned I have a little boy at home, she surprised us with plush red tail hawks to bring him as souvenirs (adorable picture attached) as well as goodies for our day trip to Sedona. 

Please give Miss Lam a fat raise & an all expenses paid tropical vacation <3

reviews.title: Phoenician- restaurant Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text:
Christine is the best. Great server and very engaging!
She made our morning breakfast a pleasant experience.

reviews.title: Awesome Food and Even Better Service
reviews.text: Brought my mother here on our last night of our stay at the Phoenician. The food was nothing short of incredible but what really made our experience wonderful was our server, Hector. Much to our surprise, he overheard that it was her 60th birthday and retirement and proceeded to go above and beyond to ensure that she felt special and celebrated. The Phoenician is very lucky to have him and when we come back we will be requesting him!
reviews.author: Brandon D

reviews.title: Excellent food and service
reviews.text: Every item we ordered was delicious.  We dined outdoors.  Hector was our server.   Hector was exceptional!  He had a solid understanding of the menu and made great recommendations.  He was prompt and personable.  He clearly had a passion for his job. Thanks for a great dining experience.

reviews.title: Mowry and Cotton experience

Highly recommend sitting in her section if you dine here.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Really great food and service provided, especially by Christine! She made us feel welcomed and attended to. Would definitely come back!

reviews.title: Mixed

reviews.title: Phoenician Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text: Phenomenal Phoenician experience at Mowry & Cotton three mornings in a row! Spoiled with exceptional service by our waitress Christine who we ended up asking for by name given how exceptional she made our experience. Food was great, outdoor ambiance was fantastic! Cannot wait to come back! 5/5 stars!
reviews.author: Brandan L

reviews.title: Summit 2022
reviews.text: Romeo was excellent!  The drinks, appetizers, desserts, and dinner were delicious!  We had a wonderful dinner 2 nights in a row.  Jaun was definitely a favorite for us as well since he helped us both nights we dined in.
reviews.author: Jamie A

reviews.title: Mowry and Cotton
reviews.text: Romeo Gwas an attentive and excellent waiter. Polite and professional. Food was great and service was high class. Will come again.
reviews.author: Steve M

reviews.title: Memorable Breakfast place
reviews.text:
As part of stay at Pheonician Resort and Marriott Elite member, They provide breakfasts, for Platinum Elite or above in the form of coupon $18.99/ person for 2 person per night. At Mowrt&Cotton, it pretty much covered light breakfast as Yogurt, Acai bowl, or Market Continental or use as a discount for A la Carte order. 

They offered in-door and out-door seating.. as I thought it quite hot for out-door seating but turn out to be not bad. They had a mist fan to help cool down the heat which I love that I could sit outdoor and enjoy atmosphere of Scottdale.

My favorite server during breakfast, her name is “Christine Lam” she is one of the best part during my stay that get me start my day with perfect breakfast. I had quite modifications make to the order and she got everything I asked for. As I continue to come back, she already remembered my order and we really enjoy talking and found out that she also know our friends that open the restaurant in Scottdale.

I also had dinner here at Mowry&Cotton, which the food was okay.. I had shrimp that was quite undercooked but for the most part is enjoyable and definitely better than in-room dining.
reviews.author: Jack K

reviews.title: Great Breakfast! thank you Christine
reviews.text: Food and service by Christine was amazing! Excellent service, she was helpful and so kind.  avocado toast , huevos rancheros we’re our top picks!
reviews.author: Ella H

reviews.title: Impeccable service at Mowry + Cotton
reviews.text: We ate the Mowry + Cotton and it was delectable. The service was spectacular. Romeo was outstanding and impressive with his service to make a memorable evening to entice us to come again.
reviews.author: Jessica

reviews.title: Delicious food even better service
reviews.text: The food was delicious!! What was even better was the service we received from Hector and Aldo.  Hector paired our meal with the perfect wine as well.
reviews.author: Remy07

reviews.title: Breakfast at the Phoenician
reviews.text: Christine was amazing and extremely accommodating!  Best service in a very long time!!  We will be back!
reviews.author: Heidi A

reviews.title: Dinner
reviews.text: Romeo was an excellent server and we throughly enjoy the meal due to his professionalism and friendliness. It was a pleasure  eating at this restaurant because of Romeo.
reviews.author: chris

reviews.title: Service at Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text: Christine was the absolute best! Great service, very attentive and just an overall sweetheart! Ask for her! You won’t regret it.
reviews.author: Ericka G

reviews.title: Delicious dinner, wait staff was amazing!!!
reviews.text: Amazing, delicious dinner. Gorgeous views. Romeo was an outstanding server. Can’t recommend this place enough!
reviews.author: Alex N

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Romeo and Rebecca took great care of our family. Even helped with our son who is a very picky eater and made something special. They also interacted with it kids and made the existence fun.
reviews.author: Brian M

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Excellent dinner with excellent service from Romeo. He was pleasant, polite and attentive. I’ll definitely come back
reviews.author: Fahad A

reviews.title: Great food, but a bit inconsistent
reviews.text: It really depends on what you order - some dishes were completely memorable, some completely not. This is across both breakfast and lunch.
reviews.author: vichy

reviews.title: Christine in Mowry & Cotton Rocks!
reviews.text: First time staying at the Phoenician Resort. Stumbled into Mowry and Cotton for breakfast. The food was outstanding and the service by Christine was even better.
reviews.author: Jennifer S

reviews.title: Great food, phenomenal service!
reviews.text: Spent our 5 year anniversary here. Food and wine were great, but our server Romeo made our night. Would def recommend.
reviews.author: Ben L

reviews.title: Wonderful Service!!
reviews.text: Our breakfast was absolutely wonderful but what made it most memorable was the amazing customer service from Christine. She made us feel right at home. My niece loved how nice she was and even made a point to tell my sister that she loved how nice our waitress was and said she was a very nice lady. Fantastic food and even more fabulous service. Thank you!
reviews.author: Veronica G

reviews.title: Perfect Meal
reviews.text: One word: Wow. The food was amazing. Our server, Jordan, was knowledgeable and had the perfect suggestions for us. It's not always eating with kids, especially in a gorgeous restaurant like Mowry & Cotton. But everything turned out perfect. Thanks Jordan!
reviews.author: Todd Nguyen

reviews.title: Great Food GREAT Service
reviews.text: Our server was Romeo and he made our night so special! He went above and beyond for me and my family! Couldn’t be happier! Wow!! Thank you so much we will be back! Amazing food and drinks as well, and the patio is beautiful!  you won’t be disappointed!!
reviews.author: Kaitlyn A

reviews.title: Excellent food and service!
reviews.text: Highly recommend their burger and fries. It was absolutely delicious! Romeo was our server and he was wonderful! We definitely will be coming back!
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: Excellent Breakfast at Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic breakfast at Mowry & Cotton inside the Phoenician Resort.  The Avocado Toast and "green" juice were very tasty.   
Our server Christine was the highlight of the meal providing excellent, excellent service as well as recommendations on options we might not have tried.  
Overall, you can't go wrong here.
reviews.author: spectrablue

reviews.title: Great dessert & service!
reviews.text: Great dinner and very friendly service. Romeo G was an excellent server who took great care of us. The desserts are the star of the show @ Mowry and Cotton! Get the banana bread pudding!
reviews.author: Miranda R

reviews.title: Birthday lunch with a dear friend
reviews.text: We wanted somewhere where we could be spoiled and enjoy a lunch - and we were!  Christine, our server, overheard it was my birthday and surprised us with bread pudding!  We loved the flatbread, the guacamole, and the brisket sandwich. It was just a lovely afternoon made even more special by the service and atmosphere!
reviews.author: pagesmorris

reviews.title: 5 star service
reviews.text: Incredible dishes, unbelievably delicious cocktails, beautiful environment. Go for the above and beyond service, as they genuinely care about your experience. Our charming waiter Christian must’ve been trained in Michelin Star restaurants with his amazing detailed service and manager Morgan was also incredibly kind & personable. Me and my sister was there just for a light dinner, but we cannot wait to return & recommend
reviews.author: yvonne eevee gonzalez

reviews.title: Wonderful Experience for the second time!
reviews.text:
This is our second visit to Mowry & Cotton for breakfast at The Phoenician Scottsdale. Christine was our server last time, and we got a chance to have her take care of us again! Christine was phenomenal; she made our visit delightful and fun! 

And did I mention the Brussel sprouts and potatoes were delicious? It was a delight to visit for the second time and have the same satisfying service!
reviews.author: Chandra T

reviews.title: Second Times the Charm
reviews.text: I love visiting Scottsdale and staying at the Phoenician. The staff is extremely accommodating and friendly. What I enjoy the most is that staff remembered my family from our first visit, in particular Christine and Jorge who both work at Mowry & Cotton. So thankful for the hospitality shown at breakfast by Christine. Al also provided amazing service during dinner. I would highly recommend asking for any of these dedicated professionals while dining at this restaurant.
reviews.author: Shema M

reviews.title: 5 Star Service
reviews.text: I have visited Mowry and Cotton each day of my stay at the Phoenician. The service is always amazing and the staff are always accommodating. My favorite meals include the BLT, French toast, avocado caesar and the Sheriff for libations. Christine and Jorge are amazing servers and it feels great to see them a year after my first visit.
reviews.author: Shay T

reviews.title: Mowry and Cotton breakfast to die for
reviews.text: Our breakfast at Mowry and cotton was awesome. The French toast and BLT are the best I’ve had. Christine’s service was also top notch! Make sure you try it
reviews.author: Asuquo M

reviews.title: Amazing Dining Experience @ Mowry and Cotton
reviews.text: The service was awesome! Our server for the evening was Hector. His attention to our needs was beyond our expectation! While the food was great, it was Hector who made the dining experience AWESOME!
reviews.author: JR

reviews.title: Terrible staff, rude bartender, skip this place
reviews.text: We came here for one night on our way back from Sedona with the family. My wife called ahead for a bday dinner and we had 8 people, 4 adults and 4 kids under 10. Very unorganized, poor management and one of the worst experiences ever at any restaurant. We asked for the cellar wine list to order a special bottle and they said they don’t have one. Asked the bar folks they had no clue so walked upstairs and ordered a 1995 Cab. One waiter came by later and said sorry sir we do have the same list. Kids food took forever that my son passed out 2 hrs in @930 and misses dessert. Multiple servers came by then we never saw anyone and they forgot other drinks and whatever my wife had planned. They brought a candle on my sons brownie sundae that wasn’t lit and it wasn’t even his bday. My wife politely asked for a manager to speak with took 10 mins for him to come and the bartender with a pony tail was sarchastic and rude to her. The manager did the usual politically correct things but it was too late. Go to a better place in Scottsdale and skip this place. I texted Marriot Bonvoy on the app and they said someone will call me today. Unfortunately, it’s too late so not celebrate anything special here for to another restaurant.
reviews.author: worldlytraveler

reviews.title: Incredible food and service
reviews.text: Great food and exceptional service in a beautiful setting.  To me a great server is as important as the food.  Over the 3 days we had Shelly and Christine serving us.  Both were outstanding who seemed to know what we wanted before we did!   They made our dining experience truly wonderful
reviews.author: Cindy B

reviews.title: Mowry & Cotton - 10/10
reviews.text:
It was my wife and I’s first trip to this resort and we were blown away by the genuine kindness of all the staff and service there. Even beyond that, the genuine conversation and “extra mile” the team at Mowry and Cotton showed was astounding. 

Our last day we Christine Lam served us and she was incredibly kind and made us want to book our next trip back just to see her again. Hopefully we’ll be able to make it back sooner than later.

10/10 would recommend and hope you get Christine! Hope to be back soon.
reviews.author: Joe S

reviews.title: Great night on the Phoenician Patio
reviews.text: We were debating between M&C and another restaurant for our last night in Scottsdale.  We made the right choice. Sat outside on the patio with great weather, well-made cocktails, and a professional, yet engaging waiter, Hector. You know how some nights you go out and it's just dinner, while other times it becomes an unplanned special event?  This was our night. Hector was fun from the start, giving great overviews of the menu and specials (wow - the halibut cheeks were so good!).  Service was spot-on and pacing of drinks and food was perfect as the sun slowly went down.  We stayed longer than expected as we weren't planning on dessert but the evening was so delightful, we didn't want it to end. So another round of drinks and a well prepared creme brulee.  While the restaurant was not easy to find initially within the Phoenician (we were not resort guests), it is in superb location looking south/east.  No sunset view, but we had a beautiful wide-open sky.  Valet or self park in the underground lot.  Thanks to Hector and the chef for a delightful evening of relaxing fun and great food.
reviews.author: alcoka

reviews.title: Wonderful view, food, and service
reviews.text: I hosted a group of 5 people for a birthday dinner at Mowry & Cotton.   The meal and service were amazing.  Our server, Adam W., was extremely helpful and personable.  We had such a nice evening---Will definitely return!  Thank you M & C.
reviews.author: @Benagain2

reviews.title: Checks all the boxes
reviews.text: We enjoyed everything, our food, the wine, the setting, and the marvelous service.  We had the guacamole with pomegranate and the bass, among other dishes.  Thank you to Adam W.!
reviews.author: lhgc999999999

reviews.title: Thanks
reviews.text: Great breakfast at Monty &Cotyon at the Phoenician. Christine, our server was super friendly and sweet!
reviews.author: Ben L

reviews.title: Hit or miss
reviews.text:
Nice outdoor patio at the Phonicean. 
Hate to ding a place during the pandemic when everyone is understaffed, but basically hit or miss. One app was good , the mushroom flatbread lacked mushrooms. The pasta main came out cold at our table and the one next to us. Would not go back.
reviews.author: michael

reviews.title: Lovely outdoor seating and  welcoming service
reviews.text: We had a dinner reservation at Mowry & Cotton and appreciated the complimentary valet parking.  We sat outside with a view of the pool area.  The lovely grounds of the Phoenician added to the experience.  I especially enjoyed the Yukon mashed potatoes with butter and chives as part of my meal, and my husband had a burger.  Expensive menu with very good service.
reviews.author: Sharon R

reviews.title: good lunch
reviews.text: went for lunch on valentine’s day. since we were fairly late i was surprised at how many people were there. highly advise a reservation for either lunch or dinner. we were promptly seated outside with a nice view of the resort. the menu was somewhat limited but had enough varierty. the food was very good and service was great as well. orices were on the high side but it is in a luxury resort so that is to be expected
reviews.author: ldgaff

reviews.title: Excellent!!!
reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience. Excellent food, excellent service and the view. Amazing. Highly recommend. Our server was Jonathan and he was the bartender as well. He made the best drinks and was very helpful helping us order.
reviews.author: Cathey1964

reviews.title: Excellent breakfast with great service.
reviews.text: Breakfast was delicious. Our server, Christine, was very pleasant, attentive and went over and above to accommodate us.
reviews.author: Terrilynn B

reviews.title: Second time ‘round
reviews.text:
This is our second time staying at the Phoenician and eating at “Monty Cotton”  the food was delicious, the setting is casual but our server
 Adam W was exceptional.   He made us feel welcomed, and more importantly he made our daughter who is a picky eater, feel like she was the most important customer in the restaurant!!    We appreciated Adam and his attention to detail.
reviews.author: Havekidslovetotravel

reviews.title: Beautiful Dinner
reviews.text: My husband & I came to Arizona to celebrate our 1st wedding anniversary.  We came to Mowry & Cotton at a last  minute spontaneous decision.  We were served by Adam W and he was fabulous.  He was so kind, courteous and very professional.  I love the ambiance in this restaurant also.  Great job 👏
reviews.author: Christina Ring

reviews.title: Highly Recommended
reviews.text: We went to this restaurant for my wife's birthday. The atmosphere was romantic and the service was delightful. The food was not only delicious, but extremely well thought out. The plating and layering of flavor was truly something everyone should experience. If you are looking for a restaurant in the area, I cannot recommend Mowry & Cotton highly enough.
reviews.author: Matthew H

reviews.title: Great experience with Lexi at Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text: Great experience with Lexi at Mowry & Cotton, Thank You SO much. She is excellent with all the services. Really appreciate it.
reviews.author: Amy M

reviews.title: 💖Server shines bright
reviews.text: Enjoyed this beautiful location for my husband‘s friends wedding. One of the nice things was the many different options we had for food at the resort. We really enjoyed the restaurant on the first level Mowry and Cotton, mostly because of our wonderful server Shelley! She was friendly, listened and gave great recommendations. She checked on us just enough to make us feel like she really cared about our experience - which she did :) She even remembered us the next day and though we weren’t in her area, she came by to say hi and even remembered our names.  A big Shout out to all the servers who have gone through this unusual time and given us hope that people still care and things will get better.
reviews.author: Tracy A

reviews.title: Delicious Steak
reviews.text: Ate here in the early evening-- no wait... nice ambience.  I had the filet and hubby had the ribeye... Both were very good and cooked as we ordered. We shared the mashed potatoes-- which was large enough to do so... they weren't anything to write home about, but they weren't bad.  Food is a la carte and pricey, but it was a pleasant meal.
reviews.author: nikki1969

reviews.title: Bri’s the best
reviews.text: Lot of food allergies and we’re amazingly accommodating. When reading my long list of allergies responded with let me know what you would like and I will let you know how we can do exactly that. Very friendly and accommodating. Delicious.
reviews.author: Lauren D

reviews.title: Slow service, limited menu
reviews.text: Food was ok if you like the limited menu options. Took a long time to get seated in a mostly empty place. Nothing horrible just expected better in resort atmosphere.
reviews.author: TimPA1004

reviews.title: Dinner at mowry and cotton.
reviews.text:
I've been to this restaurant in the past and had a great time with some colleagues. We ended up back here again for another business trip. This time I'm pretty sure our server was Daniel. Just because he was attentive to our table more than our actual server. Daniel was super nice and always willing to assist us. Even after our meal he even stopped by to check on how our dinner was.  He even apologized for the absence of our ACTUAL server. I just had to give recognition to this young man. Employees like him is what makes me tell my colleagues that we should return. 
Once again thank you Daniel.
reviews.author: Michael C

reviews.title: great food and great service
reviews.text: Great and reliable food with a wide range of choices. Sensitive to allergies and menu is clearly labelled.
reviews.author: Nancy T

reviews.title: Terrible, inept, ridiculously slow service
reviews.text:
If you are looking for excellent service to match the high prices, this place is not it.  From the host desk to the wait staff, Mowry & Cotton acted like Denny's at 5x the price.  The host station was abandoned for 10 minutes by BOTH hosts before we saw anyone.  When Tom and Maria returned they argued between themselves extensively before acknowledging any of the half dozen waiting guests.

Once seated, it took 20 minutes to get a cocktail and 35 minutes to get our appetizers once the waitress took our order.  

The assistant station was next to our table and had three bussers standing and chatting.  Our water glasses went empty repeatedly without any attempt to fill them.  Each time we had to interrupt their personal conversation to get more water.  When the waitress on rare occasion checked in she left without having our water filled.

The managers at the Phoenician should be ashamed at their utter failure to provide basic service.

I won't be going back.
reviews.author: Dave

reviews.title: Great Food
reviews.text: Wonderful food and service in a great atmosphere.  Large menu to choose from.  Attentive staff with short wait time for the food to get to the table
reviews.author: Leighton R

reviews.title: Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text: Above and beyond service and care!  Christine is AMAZING!!!  We want her when we come back. Food is great! They make you feel like you are the only table in the restaurant.
reviews.author: Ronique W

reviews.title: Fabulous !
reviews.text: Beautiful dining room with very friendly and great service staff, and a well executed tasting menu. Obviously one expects great food from a restaurant with this reputation but the whole experience was just stunning. The reception, staff, setting and service match the beautiful dishes that kept surprising.
reviews.author: Billie Theresa Mudry Spaight

reviews.title: Go early, the place is amazing and food is mighty !!
reviews.text: I went there for a business dinner with several colleagues. Sat around with a glass of wine to chat and then ordered. No pressure to order quickly. I ordered a lettuce wedge salad with vinaigrette dressing instead of the blue cheese. No problem to change. Wow, hope you like a large salad. It was fresh and the dressing perfect.  I would heartily recommend this place to all.
reviews.author: Jesse Bazarnick

reviews.title: Outstanding stay
reviews.text: My husband and I thoroughly enjoyed our stay at the Phoenician. The service was outstanding and the staff really went above and beyond to make our stay memorable. We were able to dine at several of the hotel restaurants and they are all great. Mowry and Cotton is good for any option (breakfast, lunch, or dinner). We were assisted by Christine and her customer service is impeccable! We will be back!
reviews.author: kevin b

reviews.title: Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text: Thanks to Christine for service up and above!  She made our breakfast enjoyable our entire stay.  Can’t wait to come back in the Spring.
reviews.author: Jen R

reviews.title: Phoenician
reviews.text: Christine gave us excellent service. All the food venues were amazing. Jeff in the J & G Steakhouse was fantastic and the food was incredible!!  Highly recommend!!
reviews.author: Shelly H

reviews.title: Our Favorite Breakfast Spot
reviews.text: We loved Mowry & Cotton for breakfast when visiting Scottsdale, even if not staying at The Phoenician.  Now that we’re locals, we still go as often as we can.  From perfectly crispy bacon to fantastic French toast, coupled with sitting outside and if you’re lucky enough to be served by Christine, you cannot go wrong.   Oh, free valet parking too.
reviews.author: kennyS

reviews.title: Great way to start the day
reviews.text: The best way to start the day. Had breakfast at mowry and cotton and had the privilege of having Christine as our server. She was exceptional in every way. While covid has challenged the service industry she delivered in a way that would be extraordinary in a prepandemic era. From the extra spicy bloodies and extra olives to the to go cups without asking she was a delight all around. Add that to a healthy and fresh meal (avo toast and quinoa bowl) and it was a great way to start the day. See you tomorrow!
reviews.author: bjh

reviews.title: Great Food with less than mediocre service
reviews.text:
It was my husband’s birthday and we decided to go to this particular restaurant at The Phoenician. 

The food was excellent but the service let us down. The delicious seafood main course arrived cold. There didn’t seem to be a shortage of servers and yet we did not get the service one expects from a place like The Phoenician. No idea what happened. 

Even though we told the staff that it was my husband’s birthday, they did t do anything special and delivered less than mediocre service. 👎
reviews.author: Ulya K

reviews.title: Anniversary stay
reviews.text: Went to the Phoenician resort for our 25th anniversary. Had a beautiful room. Fantastic dinner at J and G steakhouse. But we had our greatest hospitality and customer service at Breakfast this morning and Christine was our server. She made us feel so welcome and was so personable and gracious! She made a nice gentle extra fuss over our anniversary and sent on our way with a nice extra treat and extra welcome. Will never forget!
reviews.author: aztravelersmiling

reviews.title: Good food and service
reviews.text: Good food and service at Mowry and Cotton.  We had breakfast and lunch a couple of times.  Christine was very nice and courteous.
reviews.author: wjdgolf

reviews.title: Joy
reviews.text:
Great job by server Bri. two nights in a row. She made eating out a great experience. She was cordial, friendly and fun. Was able to answer questions about menu items in great detail
 No surprises when our food arrived. Very nice evening thanks to Bri.
reviews.author: Joy P

reviews.title: Tasty but expensive Breakfast
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician and had breakfast here both mornings.  We had Marriott Breakfast Vouchers worth $39 but paid an additonal $25 or so for breakfast.  We would have not eaten here and paid almost $70 for breakfast otherwise.  First morning - 2 eggs, bacon, tater tots and toast.  2nd morning - a bagel with Smoked Salmon, cream cheese, and capers.  My husband had their version of a BLT w/egg...but forgot to put on the bacon.  When pointed out, they brought it out for him.  It was still nice to breakfast at the hotel.
reviews.author: AZ-LGE

reviews.title: Phonecian dining
reviews.text: Beautiful setting relaxed. Outdoor patio well managed. Server Felix attentive pleasant and made our experience enjoyable and certain to return.
reviews.author: Ronald S

reviews.title: Breakfast
reviews.text: This is a beautiful restaurant in a premier setting.  I think all resorts and restaurants are experiencing long waits and short staffing issues.  So, the 15 minute wait turned into 45 minute wait.  Again, I think this is due to staffing issues?  Anyway, we were dining there for breakfast, food was okay, omelette was way over cooked and the coffee was just average.  The atmosphere definitely makes the experience workable.  I would try it again when back int own.
reviews.author: chefbaby2013

reviews.title: Our quest for breakfast
reviews.text: We walked into the lobby at 9:10 AM and were told  the wait would be "no more than 20 minutes." It is currently 9:56AM. Inquired a couple of times and was told there are still many ahead of us. Found people after us being let in...I will keep you posted.
reviews.author: suparbh

reviews.title: Restaurant review
reviews.text: Christine was our waitress for 12 people over 5 days and she was outstanding, remembering all our orders and anticipating our requests.
reviews.author: George B

reviews.title: Awesome BACON!!!
reviews.text: My wife loves bacon, and finding a place that has great bacon is a treat.  We had breakfast at Mowry & Cotton 4 times and every time the bacon was on point.  The rest of the food was great too. :)
reviews.author: Dan O

reviews.title: Delightful meal!
reviews.text: I'm coming back the next time I'm in Phoenix! Contrary to what some other reviews may say, this is not a typical overpriced hotel restaurant. The food is excellent and a little different. Our service was very friendly and knowledgeable. The patio is lovely, and they will allow you to reserve an outdoor table, which is a welcome option during the pandemic for some of us). Do give yourself a little extra time to either valet park or self park your car and walk through the hotel to the restaurant.
reviews.author: denverista

reviews.title: Great experience at Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text: Our server Bri was incredibly friendly and made our dining experience the best of our trip.  The food was delicious, ambiance great and service was tops all around.
reviews.author: Erika S

reviews.title: Great Dinner & Great Service 👍
reviews.text: Amazing food and great service! Luis was so friendly to our family! We would definitely recommend coming here!
reviews.author: Honeymooner051708

reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text: Hector is amazing! Top notch service!! The food was great! Vuews and atmosphere added to the ambiance.
reviews.author: Alexandra G

reviews.title: Worth the trip!
reviews.text: The food was outstanding and the service was even better.  Christine our server was the best and made us feel like friends.
reviews.author: Ken M

reviews.title: Best breakfast in Scottsdale
reviews.text: The food, the service and the overall experience were second to none. The banana pancakes and the ham and cheese omelette are the best things on the menu. The service provided by Tom, Christine and Nicole are more than enough of a reason to come back again and again.
reviews.author: Aggelo

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Just had breakfast at the Mowry & Cotton restaurant. Food was delicious and the service was over the top.  Christine our server was amazing. She made our morning.
reviews.author: Cheryl

reviews.title: Delicious and Great views!
reviews.text: Came here for a bday breakfast and lunch! Food is delish! Christine was our server and she was so nice! Even surprised me with a bday desert at the end of our meal!
reviews.author: Carolina

reviews.title: Breakfast at Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text: Just had a delicious breakfast at Mowry & Cotton. Christine was our server and she did a fantastic job. Attentive & cheerful. She was the bomb!
reviews.author: clw4341

reviews.title: Family reunion
reviews.text:
My family and I had breakfast at Mowry and cotton and we must saw that the food and service was amazing! Christine Lam was out waitress and she was super great at doing her job with great exceptional customer service experience and her fun personality! 
She will be seeing us again as we will be back and asking for her ! I highly recommend the restaurant and asking for Christine Lam! Thanks so much Christine!

reviews.title: Great Breakfast
reviews.text: Christine (our server) was fantastic in every way!  The food was also good as was the gorgeous view of the pools and grounds.
reviews.author: ron

reviews.title: Mowry & Cotton at the Phoenician
reviews.text: Mowry & Cotton at the Phoenician is beautiful and are server Bri and Armando were so very awesome paid attention to detail. Very Personable and just great company
reviews.author: Danielle J

reviews.title: Mowry Cotton
reviews.text: Christine was the best. The service and the food was excellent. Christine made my niece bday breakfast extra special with a bday cake. Definitely coming back because of her!!
reviews.author: Willie Williams

reviews.title: Rohit
reviews.text:
Luis was an absolute legend!

Recommended amazing dishes, and took care of us flawlessly!

Zero complaints. Only positive things!
reviews.author: Rohit S

reviews.title: Great buffet with amazing customer service
reviews.text: We enjoyed their breakfast buffet. Totally worth the cost and amazing customer service by Christine Lam. She was very personable and made our morning with her beautiful personality. They need to hire more employees like Christine Lam, she made our experience very pleasant.
reviews.author: Shinu s

reviews.title: Trip with friends for babymoon
reviews.text: Phenomenal resort with phenomenal staff. Everyone here is so kind, especially Christine Lam at Mowry & Cotton. Christine took extremely good care of us and went above and beyond to make sure we felt welcome. Thanks, Christine! We will be back for sure!
reviews.author: Davis C

reviews.title: Understaffed or not well managed
reviews.text: Upon arrival for our reservation, the receptionist desk was vacant and we stood around for 5+ minutes to speak with someone; then waited longer after the receptionist appeared.  We were then… sat.  Our waiter was extremely kind, courteous, & punctual with his check ins.  However, it was clear that he’d been ill informed of his table responsibilities, considering the table adjacent to us verbally complained, loudly, that they’d been sat for much longer than us, with zero check ins from a waiter (no order taken).   Our waiter apologized profusely, and you could clearly see his visible frustration with the poor communication from his peers.  Our food arrived in mismatched order, with the starter (bread) arriving well after our entrees (steak).   Food quality didn’t match the price point, as the steaks were rare vs medium, and my wife, whom I’ve never seen return a steak… did so.  Our brussel sprouts were excellent, however, our cooked asparagus was burned… badly, to the point of being inedible.  At the end of the meal, my wife and I expressed how appreciative we were to the waiter for all of his help, and ultimately tipped the man in excess of +30%.  None of the issues with our experience were his fault, and I genuinely, personally, appreciated his ‘can-do’ attitude.  I doubt I ever return to this restaurant considering the experience.  But there was a bit of restoration in our faith of humanity with our kind waiter.  This restaurant, rather its flaws being a representation of being understaffed or mismanaged, can’t continue to operate in this manner - on a Friday evening - at such a high caliber, local resort.  Things will have to change.

I asked my wife, “How many people do you think leave here and have the connections we do with the staff?”  “ How many guests does Sam remember?”  The answer will be unanswered but I can assure anyone reading this review that if you have a chance to visit The Phoenician, you will leave knowing you are remembered.  You will leave knowing you have friends.  You will leave relaxed and know you were not just a guest for 4 nights.  You were The Guest for 4 nights.

This review, I would also like to include Aisling, at the pool for taking care of us.  Each day she never skipped a beat and made a 109 degree day awesome at the pool.

Thank you to Sam, Christine, and Aisling for the great experience.

We enjoyed views of the gorgeous, well landscaped resort while driving up the hill to the main lobby for access to Mowry & Cotton.  The restaurant is a short walk from the lobby, and includes a flight of well groomed, marble stairs or use of the elevator to the access the restaurant. The hosts and hostesses were extremely warm and friendly as was our waiter who was extremely attentive throughout our visit.  The bus staff were also amazing.  The restaurant offers outside dining on the patio or a spacious interior dining room. We initially planned to eat outside but it was raining so we chose inside dining which was quiet.  The beautiful high tray ceilings add to the gorgeous dining experience. 
We started with a Cosmo ($22) and Bloody Mary ($17) which were more expensive than drinks in New York City!  We shared the Burrata dip, then we each had Mixed Green salads; all were delicious. My husband choose the Hangar steak with a side of the Yukon potatoes (additional fee), and I had the Sea Bass which was quite salty. We both felt the entrees were tasty but not overly impressive. The portions were reasonable but far from large.  The prices of the entrees are $38-$60 and no sides included. We did not have dessert. 
During our week in Scottsdale, we ate at many wonderful restaurants and other than the bill, this is not one that really impressed us. It is not a restaurant that we will need to return to upon future Az visits.

reviews.text: We went to lunch here after seeing it as the #2 restaurant in Scottsdale, AZ on Tripadvisor.  Its basically a higher end hotel pool restaurant.   Food was solid and service was solid but no one had the particular desire to return.  The problem when you are supposedly one of the top restaurants in Scottsdale is it builds expectations.  Not their fault but in the end a better than average hotel pool restaurant.  I would give it 3 1/2 stars.

reviews.title: Best visit ever
reviews.text: Fantastic food, amazing service. Sam, our waitress and now close personal friend was beyond perfect.

reviews.title: Excellent food and service at Mowry and Cotton
reviews.text: We truly enjoyed the beautiful sunrises as we had breakfast at Mowry and Cotton.  Christine Lam was an outstanding server who went the extra mile and made us feel at home.  Her service made our holiday visit special!!
reviews.author: Glenn S

reviews.title: Monthly anniversary
reviews.text: Best meal ever.  Entrees were very good, dessert was even better.  Top notch service and food, couldn’t ask for a better evening with my beautiful wife as we celebrate 46 months together. Complements to the chef on the grilled lamb and ribeye.  Israel, Samantha, and the manager took such great care of us.  Will definitely dine here again and recommend to anyone visiting the Scottsdale area.

reviews.title: Waitress was struggling / other staff good
reviews.text: Food and ambiance was good. Our server Alysia was out of it, drinks took a long time or were forgotten along with other things and she just seemed aloof as to what was going on around her. I waited tables before, so it was not as if she was in the weeds as it was later in the evening and things were somewhat slow. If you sit in her section, you might want to find an excuse to move.
reviews.author: Mike M

reviews.title: Fantastic stay & excellent service at Mowry & Cotton

reviews.title: Delicious breakfast

reviews.title: Fantastic service and brunch spot!!
reviews.text:
If you come to Mowry and Cotton, you MUST ask for Christine Lam. She is the perfect blend of professional and warm! Absolutely everything we could want (and didn’t even know we needed) was anticipated by Christine, making this the best way to start our holidays at the hotel. 

She packed up extra coffee to go and took care of our little ones with tater tots and we chatted k-pop and k-dramas. She was awesome! And though the food and setting were already great, she made everything taste even better! 

Thank you Christine!!!

reviews.title: Amazing experience at Mowry + Cotton

As a solo traveler it’s comforting to have a familiar face while dining. Also - the restaurant (and the entire resort!) was pristine. I never felt unsafe or like proper cleaning protocols were not followed.
reviews.author: Kimberly

reviews.title: Five Star Customer Service
reviews.text:
Due to the “current situation “  we ate four of our meals on property at The Phoenician. Two Wonderful breakfasts at Mowry & Cotton. Christine L was our server each day and is a total Rock Star!! Food was very good recommend the Breakfast Burrito and the Grapefruit is delicious. The aforementioned Christine made sure my wife and I had a good overall dining experience. 

Shoutouts go to Jeff at J and G as well as Kendle and Georgia at The Tavern. Food and Beverages all tasty and plentiful!

reviews.author: TGS1969

reviews.author: Steve R

reviews.title: Exceptional Service with Christine Lam

Our server,  Christine Lam, was attentive,  knowledgeable,  friendly, and took the time to get to know us better.  The service was customized to us and wonderful.  I cannot recommend more highly.  I felt safe with their food practices even during COVID. if you're looking for a wonderful time, great view and fun people you will find it here.

reviews.title: Food and atmosphere are the best!

reviews.text: Christine was fantastic. She really made our day and was a wonderful host for our table. Made us feel safe and the food was delicious too.

reviews.title: Excellent experience at Mowry & Cotton in Phoenician Hotel
reviews.text:
We visited The Phoenician hotel in Scottsdale Arizona for five days in celebrating my birthday, and ate several meals at mowry & cotton.
The food and services were outstanding, particularly our server at breakfast the day we left.
Christine Lam absolutely went above and beyond in her attitude, attentiveness, and general demeanor.
She even gave us extra food on the house for our trip home!
reviews.author: Benjamin L

reviews.title: Breakfast staff extraordinaire
reviews.text: Each morning during our stay at The Phoenician, we had breakfast at Mowry and Cotton. The food was fresh and delicious, portioned perfectly, and timely. However, the stand outs here were the servers and busers, specifically Rachael, Christine, Aedin, and Sam. With incredible personalities and easy candor, they were kind, fun, capable, and eager to please. I’ve never in my travels had such wonderful breakfast staff! Go for the food, come back for the people.
reviews.author: Lauren S

reviews.title: Safe and awesome getaway
reviews.text:
We always enjoy our time at The Phoenician. We were here in February 2020 and had to come back! It was the perfect getaway and just what we needed after being in quarantine for the past 7 months.

The hotel has done an awesome job with making sure their guests feel safe. They have taken the necessary precautions (masks wearing, social distancing) to ensure you are enjoying your trip without the worries of everything that is going on. 

Our favorite place to eat on property is Mowry and Cotton! We literally ate there everyday for breakfast and dinner. The food is soooo good and the service is even better! Our server, Christine Lam, went above and beyond to make sure we enjoyed every meal. She even got to know our VERY picky 4 year old’s preferences. She’s awesome!

Thank you to the Phoenician for providing us with a safe and awesome much needed vacation. We will be back!!!!

Andrea Y.
reviews.author: Andrea Y

reviews.title: Amazing food. Great service!
reviews.text: While it was disappointing to wait an hour to be seated for breakfast, our hostess, Christine Lam made it all worthwhile. She was efficient, empathetic and very friendly. The food was delicious!!
reviews.author: Karen K

reviews.title: Christine Lam was the best!!!
reviews.text: Christine Lam was incredibly hospitality!!! She made our dining experience amazing! We have a 2 year old and he enjoyed every moment of breakfast. She made him feel welcomed and comfortable. I highly  recommend Mowry & Cotton and most definitely ask for Christine.
reviews.author: Yaminah S

reviews.title: Food and service was excellent.
reviews.text: Food and service was excellent. Agustin really made our dining experience enjoyable, very professional, kind and attended to details. He is one of those people that keeps customers coming back. We can’t wait to be back.
reviews.author: Simona

reviews.title: Luxury at its finest with great service
reviews.text: The Phoenician Resort is luxury at its finest! It also followed social distancing, and it was incredibly clean so our family felt safe and comfortable throughout the resort. At the restaurant Mowry & Cotton, we had breakfast all three days of our stay and requested Christine Lam as our server each time. She was very friendly and made us feel like family. She even remembered all our names. Her customer service was higher than 5 stars!!! She's hands down the best server we've encountered anywhere. At the pool, Heather was very friendly and was attentive at our Cabana that we had for the day. We highly recommend spoiling yourself with a cabana rental. The hotel room and bathroom was spacious and well appointed! We are definitely coming back to the Phoenician Resort next time we are in Scottsdale!
reviews.author: Marie

reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text: We had the pleasure of dinning for breakfast at Mowry and Cotton while staying at the Phoenician.  The food was great but what made the experience most notable was our server Christine.  She was lively, personable and just fun.  Even though she was wearing a mask I could tell she was smiling.  So, Thank you Christine!  Keep up that positive energy.  It's catching!
reviews.author: Michelle G

reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text:
Very clean, felt very comfortable with social distancing as well as everyone was abiding by wearing a mask.
Kid friendly
The food was amazing!! If you are vegetarian, like us there are wonderful options.
Thank you Art and Christine and all the other staff members for your hospitality.
We will definitely coming back.
reviews.author: Gurvinderjit B

reviews.title: Beautiful Breakfast
reviews.text: I came here with my friend for breakfast while visiting him. We were greeted  with a hello and a great  smile by a lovely young woman named Melissa who seated us. We both ordered the Arizona Sun, delicious and both had eggs with bacon for me, sausage for my friend, toast and home fries,and coffee. Our server ( I think) was Rachel was Pleasant and accommodating. I really liked the way we were both treated. All staff wore masks and we were all social distance from others. Great recommendation from my friend. If I am in the area again I will return.
reviews.author: Bruce V

reviews.title: If you visit Mowry & Cotton ask for Christine
reviews.text: If you visit Mowry & Cotton you have to request Christine as your server. Service is everything and she is very attentive. The food is ok. The service is excellent. It’s like going to visit a friend. She remembers you and has great conversation. BTW Myron makes excellent drinks!
reviews.author: Gena J

reviews.title: Amazing Baby Shower!!!
reviews.text: I highly recommend holding your next event at Mowry & Cotton at the Phoenician Resort.  Not only is it a beautiful venue with fantastic food, but they are the most accommodating restaurant I’ve ever worked with.   The level of service that the restaurant manager, Jeff Gascon, and his team provided was exceptional.  They made sure every need was met, that the food was served on time, and that my guests were happy and taken care of.  Great job Jeff and team!  We will definitely hold another event at Mowry&Cotton!
reviews.author: Sandra O

reviews.title: Outstanding
reviews.text: My husband and I had the pleasure of dining here on three separate occasions during our stay. The avocado toast is an excellent choice for breakfast and the our server, Christine, graciously split the order for us. Great service and a delicious meal is a great start to any day!
reviews.author: slb787

reviews.title: Delicious food, great atmosphere, horrible service
reviews.text: Delicious food, great atmosphere, HORRIBLE SERVICE. The hotel is beautiful and loved the atmosphere of the restaurant, however, we had the worst service I can remember in a long time. Our reservations were for outside but it was unavailable when we arrived. Our server, Art, came quickly and we ordered drinks and our entrees shortly after. Once he brought the drinks, he never came back to our table. We had to order a second drink from different people, multiple times and had to request the check multiple times. Spent most of the meal frustrated and waiting. Finally a manager brought our check and apologized for our service before we mentioned anything. She was kind enough to take my entree off the bill. However, when we tried to pay the balance in cash we were told cash is not accepted. Not what we wanted to hear after the horrific service. Our food was delicious and loved our drinks. The atmosphere is great. We felt like we were given second rate service bc we were only a party of two. It was kind of them to comp my entree but given our awful experience, they should have paid for the whole thing. $115 and 2 hours of frustration, we certainly wish we would have gone somewhere else on our last night of vacation.
reviews.author: Laura

reviews.title: Incredible Service at Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text: Our server Christine at Mowry & Cotton was absolutely phenomenal! She was so kind and so quick to go above and beyond our expectations. She made our dining experience so enjoyable that we can’t wait to come back tomorrow! Someone give this gal a raise! 🙌🏻
reviews.author: Keirsten J

reviews.title: Amazing time at the Phoenician
reviews.text: Had an absolute amazing time with my wife. Facilities were amazing, service out of this world. Our server at Mowry &Cotton Christine was incredible. Could not have asked for a better time. Excited to be able to be out an about
reviews.author: Dylan

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: We had an amazing breakfast at Cotton and Mowry! I actually chose to stay at the Phoenician based on the great reviews of the restaurant and it did not disappoint. Christine our server was the best server we have ever had, was super attentive and caring and went above and beyond for us. She added some jalapeños on the side which was just a perfect addition to our meal. She definitely made the breakfast but the food itself was stellar. We probably the best green juice we have ever had at a breakfast and amazing breakfast tacos with a side of delicious tater tots. It seemed like a simple meal but was one of our top breakfasts we have ever had. Love this place and highly recommend. Hopefully your lucky enough to get Christine but even if you don’t everyone was great and the food definitely worth a trip to the restaurant.
reviews.author: Maururu1

reviews.title: We had an excellent time!!
reviews.text: We had an excellent time!! Service was incredible. Views are over the pool. Ask for Christine. She was the best. All the food we had over our 3 day stay was delicious. Restaurant is clean and everyone was wearing masks and they were sanitizing after every table. You should visit soon!
