The Phoenician is just the break that you need!!
reviews.author: Kristinas27

reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text: We stayed at the Phoenician for our anniversary. Breakfast at Mowry & Cotton was fantastic, and the service was even better. Despite Covid we felt very safe. Tables were distanced, staff wore masks, other guests wore masks when away from their tables. The condiments were sanitized and personal size. Also, Christine was our server and she took great care of us! You can tell how much she cares about her work and providing excellent service.
reviews.author: Chad W

reviews.title: Mowry &Cotton- best waitress ever!
reviews.text: When visiting Mowry &Cotton this past weekend, we had the absolute pleasure to be greeted by one of the managers, Michelle who made sure we had a phenomenal experience while there. She displayed customer service as its finest! Our waitress who took care of us this day was Christine. Christine was by far the best waitress ever! She served us with such class while also incorporating lots of laughter to keep us happy and entertained during our dining experience. She was so good she even had my 3 year old eat 2 meals and he is such a picky eater (this is a huge win in my book). I wish there was a “Christine” at every restaurant. We were here this weekend to celebrate our wedding anniversary and although she had no clue until we mentioned it at the end, she still made us feel like we were being celebrated right from her first hello. Because of this experience and service provided by Christine, Michelle and Jordan, we plan to definitely return to dine here again! Thank you Christine, Michelle and Jordan for your first class service! We will not forget you!

reviews.title: Fantastic Experience

The bar area in the lobby had a fun vibe, and the cocktails had generous pours.

We felt safe and that the appropriate steps were taken to help avoid the spread of COVID-19. If you're apprehensive about venturing back out to a resort, throw on a mask and visit the Phoenician Scottsdale.

stopped here for lunch. beautiful setting. Great menu. Good service.

reviews.title: Stumbled on this restaurant
reviews.text: Stumbled on this restaurant for dinner. The setting is spectacular. Ate outside under the stars and surrounded by palm trees. Art and Arturo provided excellent service and made our meal extraordinary. Fresh, creative food. Wonderful flavor combinations. Looking forward to my next trip to Scottsdale so I can return.
reviews.author: Scenic587764

reviews.title: Wonderful, inventive lunch in a stunning setting!
reviews.text: Ambience, service, exceptional food and drinks, comfortable setting! We especially loved the pheasant soup and the harrisa lamb tacos, but everything was top notch! At the Phoenician resort. A treat for lunch!
reviews.author: Ryan W

reviews.title: Long lines and mediocre food
reviews.text:
In fairness, we were staying over Christmas, so I can see why it would be busy. However, 25-30 minute wait times for brunch when half the tables were empty felt frustrating. It seemed they had only bare bones staff as it was the holidays, and didn't consider the large amount of guests staying at the hotel?

The food was average to below average, and our server was very bubbly and friendly, but was never around when we needed him. I did appreciate the number of gluten free items, but this didn't really make up for the food being so 'meh'. If the prices had reflected this, perhaps we would've been expecting less in terms of food quality, but this was not the case.  I can't recommend, sadly.
reviews.author: MTVandend

reviews.title: A superb mouthwatering lunch
reviews.text: We stopped in for an impromptu lunch.  The food and presentation was superb. We’re vegetarian and there were enough options to put together a wonderful meal. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: A great experience
reviews.text:
We had lunch at this amazing restaurant located inside The Phoenician Resort in Phoenix.  It's the lap of luxury with a welcoming "home" feeling.  Inside and outside seating available to enjoy the view and the food.  The menu is creative, taste-filled, generous portions, that end with new-to-me desserts. Incredible taste treats!  Mallory provided restaurant background (upon request),  was knowledgeable about the menu, and fast service!  I would eat here weekly (if I could:)  

They have a creative way to keep the birds away from outside diners -- a falconer with Harris Hawks, who came to our table to answer our numerous questions about the very friendly and tame hawk.  A breathtaking experience as well!

reviews.title: A great way to start and end the day
reviews.text: The Phoenician Hotel in Scottsdale, Arizona, offers several excellent dining options and a three-day visit gave my wife and I an opportunity to sample all of them. Mowry and Cotton is a great way to start and end the day. Open for breakfast at 6:30 a.m. Monday through Friday and at 7 on Saturday and Sunday, we started with Brioche doughnuts, coconut, raspberry and yuzu curd, a fruit bowl and a bowl of oatmeal with cinnamon, raisins and brown sugar. My wife had stuff French toast with berries, ricotto cheese, maple syrup and pork sausage links. I had Eggs Benedict with smoked pork, poached eggs, English muffin, hollandaise sauce and gem salad. Later, we had dinner...buttermilk buns, veal and black garlic meatballs with mozzarella and tomato jam, Rye Caesar salad with gem lettuce, grilled bread and parmesan, Atlantic halibut, whole roasted sea bass, lemon meringue pie and bread pudding. Great meal with a classy atmosphere, a good view and outstanding service.
reviews.author: Taylor B

reviews.title: stop by
reviews.text:
Great food, service & atmosphere.  Stopped by for a quick lunch while arriving in Scottsdale.  The food & atmosphere were excellent.
Trying to find our way around the Phonecian was a little difficult not well marked as where to go.  The place is very large & has several restaurants.
reviews.author: PattiEmm

reviews.title: Mowry and Cotton is not as good as the former Terrace Room
reviews.text:
I have been dining at the Phoenician ever since it opened. The Terrace Room and Mary Elaine were among the finest restaurants in Scottsdale. Today what was Mary Elaine is now more of an informal restaurant featuring steak, which I know has great appeal. But the gourmet aspect of the good old days is gone. And then there was Window on the Green, which was a Southwestern gourmet restaurant.

I find Mowry & Cotton to be a nice place for lunch, especially when the weather is mild and one can eat on the patio. But their lunch menu is very limited and does not offer that extra touch of elegance that was once the hallmark of the Terrace Room. As a result I only dine there about once every six months instead of once a month.
reviews.author: Lewis D

reviews.title: Healthy and tasty choices pus a nice setting.
reviews.text: The menu was interesting with many healthy choices. My entree was loaded with crunch, color, and flavor not to mention a very generous portion. reviews.title: Pretty Shocking
reviews.text: I had brunch here yesterday with 2 girlfriends. We sat inside and had a pleasant waiter named Austen. We enjoyed our meal and were waiting on Austen to come back so we could order another round but instead someone else came by and left our check. We decided to go ahead and cash out and put our cards out on the bill but no one came around to collect it.  After about 10 or 15 minutes I waived down someone clearing another table and he cashed us out. I understand that perhaps it was the end of Austen's shift and he had to leave, but it's almost like he left and no one was put in charge of our table. So, we're leaving there on kind of a sour note, and as we're walking toward valet we realize none of us has cash to tip the valet. We inquire at the stand about an ATM but the nearest one is not close at all. Luckily, our car is literally RIGHT THERE so the valet guy had to walk about 5 steps to get it and drive it up. We let him know we didn't have cash and asked if we could Venmo him a tip. He said no. We apologized and said we just have no cash and he looks at us and says "Yeah, thanks a lot. Really appreciate it" in a COMPLETELY sarcastic and hateful tone.  For such a nice establishment, this was uncalled for and quite shocking. We tried to offer a solution for not having cash. And honestly, he had to walk 5 steps to the car - not like he ran to a parking garage, up some stairs, and drove it some distance.  Between being ghosted by the servers and talked to like this by valet, I have no desire to go back. We can find more pleasant places to have an egg benedict.

reviews.title: Great Food & Service
reviews.text: Mowry & Cotton is located inside the Phoenician Resort.  It's tucked away on the lower level of the resort but has an extremely comfortable feel and atmosphere.  We enjoyed dinner here twice and highly recommend.  First off, their flatbreads are excellent!  We had their roasted squash flatbread and it absolutely melts in your mouth.  We also had their Charred Hanger Steak, excellent and tender and a great seasoned taste.  Their Prime Pork Steak is a must!  I'm not a big fan of ordering pork at "medium", but the flavors of the coating popped out with each bite.  As far as service goes, they are top notch.  Christian, Art, and Doba (?) were very accommodating and attentive.  Christian even recognized us the next day and continued with his excellent service.  I highly recommend Mowry & Cotton!

reviews.title: Enjoyable way to start the weekend

reviews.title: Great derby party !!

reviews.title: Great breakfast!
reviews.text: We’re staying at the Phoenician for the weekend.  Because we are titanium elite with Marriott, breakfast is included.  Normally it’s a specific dish included, but they let you use the value of the dish as a credit towards ordering other choices.  Our server, Christian, was on point- charming and attentive (even making our daughter laugh).  Looking forward to going back tomorrow.
reviews.author: Emily P

reviews.title: Fun and scrumptious!
reviews.text: We always enjoy M&C!  Food, service, surroundings, and, oh yeah - the food!  Buns, beets, and beef!  That is my fav, but there is going to be something for those less hearty.
reviews.author: wyoeric

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: The food and ambiance were amazing. Healthy fresh food reasonably priced.i am looking forward to returning on my next visit to Scottsdale
reviews.author: Ellen F

reviews.title: Great Lunch
reviews.text:
We had one of our best lunches in Phoenix.
Great burger, fries and sandwich.
Would definitely come back and would love to try your dinner menu.
Great attention to detail.
reviews.author: Corgeb

reviews.title: Very relaxed atmosphere with excellent food
reviews.text: I enjoyed my brunch on the patio.  It is a really relaxing setting.  The waitstaff is attentive without being intrusive and the menu is quite creative with a wonderful food selection.
reviews.author: susan142019

reviews.title: Mowry and Cotton at the Phoenician Resort
reviews.text: A must place to eat when in the Phoenix area.   The cuisine is wonderful.  The staff is sure to ask of any eating preferences or allergies.   They cater to everyone.  You don’t leave hungry or with an empty pocket.
reviews.author: kathibuxman

reviews.title: Delish!!
reviews.text: From start to finish - expert friendly knowledgeable service, lovely cocktails, extraordinary wine list, and extremely delicious food. Everything on the plate - one to the next was remarkable. Their menu changes seasonally - hope you get a chance to try something as good as we did!!!
reviews.author: jeffreysU5882PO

reviews.title: Unique and Elegant
reviews.text: Beautiful views, unique menu and delicious drinks. I was pleasantly surprised by the pheasant. Nice to try some new and creative dishes.
reviews.author: Shaly V

reviews.title: great food
reviews.text: our first visit to celebrate my birthday.. great ambiance  great food and great location. enjoyed the outdoor
reviews.author: DayTrip737860

reviews.title: Chef Tandy is the best
reviews.text: Love Mowry & Cotton since I met Chef Tandy in one of the wine pairing dinner. She’s amazing, her cooking is unbelievable.
reviews.author: Crystal

reviews.title: Myron for the win!
reviews.text: Well we checked into the Phoenician and heard there was a free mixology lesson.  True story: the mixology lesson is Myron.  Tell him the type of flavor and vibe you’re looking for and he’ll make it from scratch.  Excellent!
reviews.author: Megan P

reviews.title: Mowry & Cotton Bartenders
reviews.text: Myron is a superb bartender and mixologist. Highly recommend coming here to have a great cocktail and even better conversation. Just don’t say you want a bourbon cocktail unless you really mean it 😉
reviews.author: Gary P

reviews.title: Must try
reviews.text: We had dinner at this restaurant! What a great and relaxing atmosphere! Our waiter was Art , very professional, knowledgeable and friendly. The food was just as great. I got the Tuna on the menu, as well as some Brussel Sprouts. We are local, living in Chandler and just wondered around the Phoenician Resort and decided to stay there for dinner! It was the best decision and we ended up our Saturday night the best way ! The food was not too big , but very fresh and delicious. I also had The Scotch Cocktail and we had some dessert - the S’mores and the Lemon Meringue Pie.
reviews.author: diangeltravel

reviews.title: Breakfast
reviews.text: My family and I ate breakfast at the Mowry & Cotton restaurant threes times during our vacation and each time was just as pleasant as the last. I personally had the Turkey Hash every morning and loved it each time. The waiters were always quick to get our drinks and the food never took more than ten minutes from order time to be served. The last two days we had the same waiter; the second day with him, he welcomed us back. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone traveling in the Phoenix area. 10/10 wud wreckamend.
reviews.author: 116_Luke_116

reviews.title: Birthday dinner with friends
reviews.text: Dinner was fabulous. Service was out of this world. Louis was fantastic. He made the experience one of a kind. Then, out if the blue, the chef Tandi came to chat with our table. It felt like we were VIP. great experience from start to finish.
reviews.author: Jpavness

reviews.title: Mowry and Cotton
reviews.text: Dinner at Mowry and Cotton. The Prime Pork Steak is delicious, flavorful, tender, cooked perfectly. We also enjoyed the grilled asparagus.
reviews.author: Susie T

reviews.title: Mowry and Cotton for the family
reviews.text: What a wonderful experience, I came in for dinner with my family. We started with the corn and chorizo dip, a must have! Beautifully remodeled restaurant and fantastic service.
reviews.author: Yovahnna Aguilar

reviews.title: Best Bread
reviews.text: The staff at Mowry & Cotton, especially Christine and Myron, made my 2 week stay so enjoyable, with daily breakfasts and a new addiction to their Noble burrata bread which is to die for.
reviews.author: LJZ

reviews.title: nice casual dining
reviews.text: had a lunch and a dinner there and both were good. We had seafood sandwiches for lunch that were very good. Dinner was a steak for me and I don't recall what my wife had, but she liked it.
reviews.author: ToomuchsnowTom

reviews.title: Spoiled by the Staff- Andrew and Alex
reviews.text:
What a wonderful restaurant and the STAFF was by far the best ever.  We arrived early to play bocce ball, and ANDREW actually brought us our bottle of wine to the bocce ball area, to savor while we played.  We enjoyed a lovely bottle of wine on the beautiful grounds of the Phoenician resort, whilst playing bocce ball and catching up with friends.

The evening only got better, when we ate at Mowry and Cotton- FANTASTIC restaurant.  The food was amazing, and Andrew checked on us a couple times just to make sure things were perfect.... and they were.  Alex our server was great too.  The chef's new and delicious entrees were nothing short of spectacular.  

Andrew even came over to say goodbye when he left for the evening. We will certainly be telling all of our friends about Andrew, Alex and Mowry and Cotton.  WELL DONE.
reviews.author: lacapitalrussa

reviews.title: Great for breakfast and lunch
reviews.text: Great outdoor dining venue for breakfast and lunch with eclectic menu - great service ; falconry to keep birds away provides inventive entertainment
reviews.author: Trek2019

reviews.title: YUM
reviews.text: The food and service were amazing.  You can't go wrong with dining here.  The enviroment is very relaxing - eat indoors or out
reviews.author: TropicalBreezeZz

reviews.title: A MUST try restaurant!
reviews.text:
I have been to Cotton & Mowry a couple of times, including on a couple of date nights with my husband and dinner with our kids. Their concept is pretty cool, where it’s like a shareable style of a modern American menu.

We have tried a couple of their menus and every single time we finished our meals we were already looking forward to our next time! Service has always been wonderful, and the food simply incredible, to the point where we were either speechless or 💯 %  letting out a YUUUMMMM or a OH MY GOSH - kids included!! There’s something on menu for anyone, and if you haven’t been there yet, gooooo and give it a try! With the weather now being perfect for the outdoors, the patio sitting provides a nice view as well. The atmosphere is casual and nice. 
I was trying to choose a few of our favorite dishes, but it’s honestly so hard to!! I’ll add a few, but there’s nothing we have had that we would not want to have again! 

From the Hearth Oven:
Buttermilk Buns, The Squash or the Roasted Tomato Flatbread

Side:
Mowry french fries

From the starters:
Corn &Chorizo dip  

Vegetables:
Grilled asparagus 
Crispy potatos

Meat:
“Prime” Pork Steak

Dessert:
Apple crumble
reviews.author: Sue P

reviews.title: Extremely accommodating considering the circumstances
reviews.text: My family and I had last minute arrangements and considering it being a very busy holiday Lilly the hostess was incredibly accommodating. My family and I got a reservation last minute and although we would’ve preferred the steak house Lilly convincingly won me over to mowry and cotton. This place is amazing the service was top notch and let me tell yah the food is 5 star! Thank you Lilly and team for the amazing service and working on Easter.
reviews.author: Richard H

reviews.title: Unique valley restaurant
reviews.text: I came here with my friend for dinner in March and overall enjoyed my experience. My friend has some food allergies and our server was very knowegable on the dishes and ingredients in each one. The menu is very unique compared to other restaurants in the valley We had and loved the chopped salad, squash flatbread and the bass to make tacos. We will be back!
reviews.author: Abigail defalco

reviews.title: Dinner with Friends
reviews.text: What a beautiful property, well designed and approachable place! It’s comfy for a drink date or brunch. I dined with a friend for dinner, server was knowledgeable and accommodating to our needs. Food was outstanding and would please a wide variety of tastes. Nan’s buns are a great sharing appetizer.
reviews.author: molly g

reviews.title: Excellent restaurant
reviews.text: My family had a fantastic dinner here!  One of the best meals we’ve ever had. Although our server couldn’t answer some food related questions, still a 5 star meal!
reviews.author: Brian T

reviews.title: Delicious food and beautiful views
reviews.text: We were able to eat at Mowry and Cotton for breakfast during our stay the Phoenician. The food options are so exceptional and the views are gorgeous. Each morning my husband and I had completely different breakfasts and were always served very quickly.  You cannot beat a delicious breakfast with a warm Arizona sunrise over looking the water!
reviews.author: Justine and Matthew Metzler

reviews.title: Beautiful Poolside Setting
reviews.text: I had the best brunch buffet at Mowry and Cotton.  The fruits are perfectly ripened...the biggest blueberries.   They use the freshest ingredients and do the basics with a flair. Dinner was very nice also.  I had their salmon but everyone enjoyed their dishes.  Wonderful wine list.   Service was attentive and decor is upscale southwest and casual.
reviews.author: sheelaeyy

reviews.title: Yum
reviews.text: Had breakfast here every morning of my stay.  The seabass for dinner is also amazing and great to split between two people.
reviews.author: sjlewis82

reviews.title: Wonderful for locals and tourists alike!
reviews.text: I have had dinner at Mowry and Cotton several times...once for our wedding anniversary, once to take friends to dinner, one of whom is vegan, and once with a group of ladies in my investment club.  Each time the food, service, and ambiance were outstanding!  Chef Tandy visited our table on one occasion and was so personable while she told us about her favorite menu items and what inspires her cooking.  There are so many wonderful and unique items on the menu that each time everyone was very happy with their choices.  With the large group of women we ordered 7-8 dishes and shared them all, to include the amazing Buttermilk Buns with Citrus Sea Salt Butter and Duck Fat Fig Butter...YUM, to the Roasted Squash with watercress and the Whole Roasted Seabass with ancho chili and lime crema!If you have out of town guests, or friends who have never been to the Phoenician Resort, start or end your evening (or both!) with a fireside drink on the Thirsty Camel's patio with a gorgeous view of Phoenix and our amazing sunsets!  It is alway a treat!
reviews.author: APMLS5

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: This was our first visit since the restaurant at the Phoenician was redone as Mowry and Cotton.  Our experience was excellent.  Our server, Jacqueline, was terrific at explaining the menu.  Our group ordered several different salads, entrees, and sides.  Each was delicious. We were  disappointed that they now charge for bread.  That seemed out of line with a restaurant of this quality.
reviews.author: sojouner2

reviews.title: SUPER
reviews.text: We have had such  wonderful experiences at the restaurant. The staff always takes the time to make sure that your time there is the best it can be. The service, food and atmosphere is exemplary !
reviews.author: Navigator55082492361

reviews.title: Wonderful Place
reviews.text: Always receive great service. Kristina is fantastic. Food is always delicious. We would recommend this place to anyone who stays at the resort and to the local community of Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Tour52590661461

reviews.title: The Mowry Girls
reviews.text: Really enjoyed ourselves.  Loved having the bird come in to say “hello”.  Bringing some good friends for lunch today.

reviews.title: Amazing buffet brunch
reviews.text:
The buffet brunch is fabulous. Excellent selections and food is VERY fresh. There's a made-to-order omelette bar, which is great. 

The fruit selection is lovely and they put out smaller portions of food, which is changed very frequently, so everything is fresh and beautifully presented.

reviews.title: Lovely environment, great wait staff and delicious, inventive food
reviews.text: We had a marvelous breakfast here this morning.  Coffee was excellent (always a good start).  The turkey hash was amazing.  Chorizo tacos were also very good.  Fruit plate had a wider variety of fruit than I have ever seen!   The restaurant is beautiful, with a wall of glass adjacent to a patio overlooking the Valley.  Our waiter was excellent.  We will come here again!

reviews.title: Breakfast
reviews.text: Relaxed service and casual attire welcome. Indoor and outdoor seating available. A la carte or buffet style available (recommend buffet if looking for a fast breakfast option). First come seating. No reservations. Ask to sit in Jorge's section, he is a wonderful asset to this restaurant.
reviews.author: bestfamilyadventures

reviews.title: Wonderful restaurant with great food!
reviews.text: We had breakfast here one morning and really enjoyed the food. The place is very pretty and you can eat outside if you wish. I like the health selections.
reviews.author: temasteele

reviews.title: Elegant Hotel Restaurant with fresh, seasonal food
reviews.text: My family dined at Mowry and Cotton on Christmas Eve and we were beyond pleasantly surprised with the variety of seasonal flavors and menu items that were vegetarian and pescatarian friendly. High ceilings and ornate table dressings add to the resort feel. I especially enjoyed the rutabaga mashed potatoes! It was fun twist on the traditional starchy side dish. The kale and quinoa salad was also wonderful. Our server was friendly and attentive. We will definitely be back.
reviews.author: jess darke

reviews.title: A Birthday to remember!?
reviews.text:
I took my mother here for her Birthday. Our reservation was scheduled for 5pm arrived at 4.45 pm. Attempted to sit at the bar for cocktail we were told by bartender that they are closed till 5pm. Said he could serve us but it will take time as he has to do more set up.!??
5pm
We started off with the buttered rolls (8) very good. After 30 minutes looking over the menu and finding out that everything was shareable we decided to split the grilled squash with feta. (10) and the Half Pheasant order (29) . The veggies were amazing. However the Pheasant was dry tasted as if it was made 2 days ago then nuked in the microwave. Huge disappointment. Our waiter never came over to ask us how our meal was cause if he did I would have told him about the pheasant.
When I made this reservation 2 days before I told them it would be a Birthday and please have a candle in the dessert.  Welp that didn’t happen we ordered the S’mores and no candle!? It was embarrassing but I said there was suppose to be a candle in this as it is a Birthday tonight. They took it away about 10 minutes later they brought it back out with a candle and wrote on a plate Happy Birthday w/ 2 chocolate covered strawberries. It was a nice after thought. Wish they did this the first time.
Other then that would I return- probably not.  The service was lacking, the pheasant was dried out. 
My beer was flat. I don’t know...For the prices and atmosphere it could have been so much better

reviews.title: Worth a visit if you like fresh wholesome food.
reviews.text: Not inexpensive but the food is far fresh, delicious and the service is superb. We had the burger and fish and both were excellent.
reviews.author: EliteTravellers

reviews.title: Surprise visit
reviews.text: A work colleague brought a group of us that was in town for a conference.  The hotel and restaurant is over the top.  I wish the conference was held at Phoenician.  We had great food and good service.  I loved the green peppers side dish.

reviews.title: Not vegetarian friendly
reviews.text: The staff at the restaurant is really great, but the menu lacks non-meat options. There's not a single vegetarian entree (salads aside) and even some of the vegetable sides have meat in them. Sorry guys, but you need to offer some diversity in your menu if you're the primary restaurant serving a major resort.
reviews.author: julp29

reviews.title: Star Treatment
reviews.text:
Beautiful outdoor dining venue at the gloriously renovated Phoenician Hotel. Greeted with “Happy Anniversary” by everyone who passed us. David, our waiter, was friendly and professional. Daniel, the busboy, was wonderful, too. The food was perfect for a travel weary couple, and the buttermilk dinner buns were a comforting highlight.  
Creative craft cocktails were memorable....try the Bourbon and Boujee, its a winner. My husband wanted a gin martini and David returned with a local gin and a careful explanation from the bartender revealing how much he listened and aimed to please. Spectacular service.
Surprise (gratis) Anniversary dessert and champagne made us feel so special. Quiet and cool atmosphere, literally and figuratively. Marvelous place. If we lived here, we would go once a week.
reviews.author: Victoria Z

reviews.title: Typical Resort Restaurant
reviews.text: Beautiful outdoor seating with view of resort pool and grounds.  Service was good, but the food was one hit and one miss. The issue is that for the price there are much better places to go in town.
reviews.author: Dave J

reviews.title: A lovely outdoor dining experience
reviews.text: A very nice menu, great service and a really nice setting. A tradition for our first night at The Phoenician.
reviews.author: Scott A

reviews.title: Incredible gem at the Phoencian!  (great for Gluten Free)
reviews.text: We ate several meals here during our stay at the Phoenician and the food and service was impeccable every time.  Dinners had a variety of protein including 3 types of steaks (all great, but I liked the hangar steak best).  Breakfast was classic with great pancakes, eggs and so on.  BONUS: This place has access to a dedicate Gluten Free kitchen and all the staff get it.  If you have celiac among your group, you will feel safe with every bite.
reviews.author: davidfromop

reviews.title: Cocktails were fabulous!...food was okay
reviews.text: We had the best cocktails before dinner...and afterwards. The meal started off well with the biscuits on the menu. They were really good and the butter that came with them was very tasty! Our second course was good. It was a salad which we enjoyed. Once we got to dinner I ordered the tuna and was warned it was spicy. Not sure where the spice was in the wasabi they put on the plate but the meal was bland. Disappointing because this is a beautiful place to go eat! I give this restaurant a 10 on the view and the ambiance!

reviews.title: good food but very experimental
reviews.text: need more options for people who will have to eat there every meal of the day for families who come from far away for more than a few days. Food is too experimental. Need a few comfort food.

reviews.text: Restaurant im "The Phoenician"-Hotel mit rustikaler Einrichtung. Sehr gute internationale Küche zu vertretbaren Preisen bei perfektem Service.
reviews.author: marc7704

reviews.title: Casual and Good
reviews.text: We enjoyed a casual and nice dinner with friends. This was a little bit different. Plates are made for sharing. We ordered a lot  of food - flatbread,meat balls, brussel sprouts,shrimp,tacos and salads. Everything comes out as it is ready and so we had plenty of food on the table all at once. Apple crumble for dessert. All the food was good and we had a nice evening.
reviews.author: Louvain71

reviews.title: Disappointing Dinner
reviews.text: Disappointing and expensive choice for a nice dinner. Cowgirl steak covered with unappealing garnishes and salmon presented on tasteless grilled lettuce and circled by stings of salsa bits. Salmon, though, was delicious. Neighboring table had guys working or playing on laptops, not there for dining. Simply not an inviting setting for a nice dinner.
reviews.author: azinfrance

reviews.title: Sharing is Caring
reviews.text:
Ok, the thought of sharing my meal with my husband presented a couple of problems; one I am vegetarian, two, he is not. The restaurant in The Phoenician Scottsdale, Mowry & Cotton is designed with sharing in mind. With casual elegance and open feel, we both felt right at home. Our server Dora explained the various options and the ordering began!

Let’s just say, we didn’t leave hungry. Vegetables to die for but first, let’s talk about the buttermilk roll and oh what a roll it is. Who says you can’t have dessert first? Not technically dessert, but so warm and buttery and just a pinch of salt presented on a small board with a smattering of butter and fresh blueberries, the adventure was about to begin.

We chose a few vegetables to start with the favorite being charred Brussels sprouts with chicory kimchee followed up at a close second with the caramelized cauliflower served with just the right amount of calabrian chile topped with a pine nut sauce. Crispy potatoes dressed with chorizo (on the side per my request) horseradish and tomato brava hot sauce completed our veggie trio.

My wine of choice for the evening was Paul Hobbs, Crossbarn Chardonnay and I am now a fan. 

Chef Tandy Peterson creates with panache. Another restaurant, the same dish, would just not be the same dish. Case in point my whole pacific striped bass. Stated on the menu to be shared with the entire table, I am sorry, that just was not gonna happen. Ok, hubby did get a sample scooped up in a small tortilla however, since I was not going to taste his carnivore fare, well let’s just say, I was a bit selfish. But who could blame me? Just try letting go of the ancho chili, corn, cotija, and lime crema dressed fish and you will understand. 

I took my time enjoying the bass so my husband could dive in to his charred hanger steak and would you believe it, pheasant? That’s a lot of food. I was tempted to remove a bit of the wild mushroom and pickled blueberry which adorned his steak but after all, he respected my selfishness so fair is fair. He was so very happy with the steak but was over the moon with the pheasant both tender and cooked to perfection so I was told.

Dora thought we had better save room for dessert and when the restaurant general manager, Andrew dropped off the apple crumble, we had to strike up a conversation to let him know what a glorious evening we both had and that Dora hit the nail on the head with all she had recommended. As we eyed the crumble, what appeared to be a small green apple was in reality, ice cream. No kidding, ice cream. That did it, hands down one of our best dining experiences in Scottsdale and one we will more than likely, sing the praises to all who will listen.

p.s. my husband took the remaining steak and pheasant back to our room so he could enjoy it for breakfast. I am serious.
reviews.author: Susan S

reviews.title: Gorgeous hotel, great brunch
reviews.text: We had brunch here on the weekend and were impressed with the service and the food. We decided to eat outside on the patio since the views are spectacular. They turned on the misters for us since it was a hot morning which made it much more comfortable. We started with the “fromosa journey” - champagne with 3 different types of sorbet. Super yum and not too sweet- even my husband (more of a beer guy) enjoyed them. To eat we had the breakfast bruschetta to start and the salmon salad bowl and shrimp and grits. They were all wonderful and our favorite was the bruschetta- soft scrambled eggs, melty Oaxaca cheese, crab and greens on top. Our favorite part was the onsite falconer and falcon (named Tony) who were hanging out on the patio and keeping the critters away.  We will be back!
reviews.author: Chevstar29

reviews.title: Great brunch menu
reviews.text:
We had both dinner and brunch at the restaurant. I would highly recommend the brunch over dinner. I like their brunch menu much better plus it’s cheaper. 

Must get the Monkey bread and shrimp & grits!! The monkey bread was so soft and fluffy, and drizzled with cream cheese and fig jam....I could have easily devoured a whole order by myself. 

The shrimp & grits was extremely tasty. It was served with crispy bacon and garlic. Yum! I saw a table ordered onion rings, which was not on the menu and they looked so good. I’ll probably try them the next we are there.

Service is good, staffs are friendly and courteous.
reviews.author: Mytrips

reviews.title: Good food and beautiful setting, but service can be spotty
reviews.text: The food was good, but it would be nice to have more options. That is especially true of the buffet they have on the weekends. And It is a little pricey. Breakfast for two will run about $60-$70 dollars. There is a nice feature--to keep the birds away there is a "hawk handler". As soon as the hawk appears the other birds disappear. There is a water cooling feature (mister) but it was only turned on during the weekend. Not sure why.  The hostesses/greeters were not friendly or helpful, which was different from everyone else at the hotel. The wait staff is good, but you can tell the younger servers have not been trained. They however are friendly and helpful.
reviews.author: Vivet M

reviews.title: A must for breakfast!
reviews.text: So impressed with this resort breakfast restaurant. We only had breakfast there but looked forward to a daily treat of exceptional choices, flavour and presentation. Due to the length of our stay we tried almost everything on the menu and one day of buffet. We certainly enjoyed the menu over the buffet but it was also very good. Service was good, although the hosteses could use a bit more training, servers were great!
reviews.author: Lisa S

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
This was our 1st night on vaca and we thought we'd just stay in the hotel for dinner. WOW are we glad we did. This resturant is classy but casual with a great variety.
Service was really great too. From starters to dessert everything we ordered was yummy.
reviews.author: Deborah O

reviews.title: What you should know...
reviews.text:
We loved seeing the new Mowry & Cotton. They really transformed the room and the feel of the old Terazza. We loved it! Had a great mean and service. 

We had the Brussel spouts for an appetizer - big bowl! So much flavor. 
I have the Mussels for dinner, incredible! The bowl of broth they are in is one of my favorites and has a real kick with the spices. My husband had the Ribeye and it was perfectly cooked. The Blue cheese was great as well on that. 

We had the S'mores pis for dessert, probably one of the funnest and best desserts I've had - probably because it's such a great childhood flavor memory!! 

Will go back again and again!
reviews.author: tigerlilykelly

reviews.title: Very tasty
reviews.text: I liked our meal. Although it was served in stages and it was prepared differently I liked the dinner and the breakfast we had here. At first I was wondering way so many birds were eating away from the left over food but, I was also surprised to see that they use a Falcon and a trainer on sight so that the Falcon can keep all birds from disturbing the guest. My 11 yr old son was as fascinated as I was with this.
reviews.author: Eve M

reviews.title: Great staff; great meal
reviews.text: Friendly attentive staff. Great iced tea, though I guess that’s hard to bungle. Nice view through large windows on deck over the pool. The chicken wings are different than your average wings with charred breadcrumbs and cashews with a yogurt and current sauce- they are awesome! The bison burger was better than the hamburger and the chopped salad  was fantastic with avocado, corn and black currents and pheasant.
reviews.author: michael r

reviews.title: Service was great, fast was a little different but tasty but was a little pricey :(
reviews.text:
Service was great, fast was a little different but tasty but was a little pricey :( Cam e back for breakfast to the same .

They also need to provide napkins or a dish so  your utensils don’t touch the table with all the scavenging  gracious bird walking on all the tables
reviews.author: CANADIANOntario

reviews.title: A Nice Place for Breakfast
reviews.text: Mowry and Cotton is a good choice for breakfast.  The staff is friendly and accommodating.  The menu has a lot of options as well.  There is a kids menu too.
reviews.author: Sheryl M

reviews.title: Staged dining is not for us!
reviews.text: We were looking forward to a nice dinner with some friends .... We had a night of waiting! The food itself was tasty but our food arrived in stages with long waiting periods in between. We were told that this is the way they serve your food....they decide what you want when....while we were expecting our order to arrive all together. No one explained this concept to us. And given that we arrived hungry, all of us were very upset by the staged dining.
reviews.author: JTokar

reviews.title: Umm... No!
reviews.text: What a disappointment. They're trying too hard to be hip--bright lights and loud noise do not make for a relaxing and enjoyable meal. The food was okay, but may have been better--I'm not sure because I was so turned off by the ambiance, or lack thereof. I actually felt like I was eating in a cafeteria. Needless to say, we won't be back.
reviews.author: Jay F

reviews.title: Relaxing dinner
reviews.text: Dinner at Mowry & Cotton was great. Relaxing resort setting outside near pool. Service was great and not rushed. Server was eager to discuss the menu options and seemed eager to make recommendations. Enjoyed dessert with a beautiful sunset. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: JosephPaddy

reviews.title: Delicious
reviews.text: The grilled shrimp is cooked on an open fire.  Everything was delicious, and the service was wonderful.
reviews.author: kathryn m

reviews.title: Innovative
reviews.text: Surprisingly good and different from the old restaurant.  Service was excellent, but that is not surprising.
reviews.author: christJ9628RL

reviews.title: Don't believe the bad reviews
reviews.text:
Ok, so it may not be a burger place for kids, and I ate at dinner time (no grilled cheese sandwiches), but this place has unreal food with imagination and flair.  
I had salami flat bread with arugula that was simple yet incredible.  Then I had lamb street tacos that were juicy, not gamey and a perfect blend of med and southwest.  Finally I had the brisket soup.  If you don't like this, you are an alien.  Service was great, and even though it ain't cheap, it was WELL worth it.  Great value.  I get it - this isn't the ordinary place for kids dinner. If you want that, go hit Ruby's diner.  Don't believe the haters on here.
reviews.author: jim p

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: This is one of those places that has a smaller, 'interesting' menu. As in....why can't I get a Ceasar with some shrimp? Why are all the salads so different. Different and cool is great. But I think there should be some sure fire hits available too. The menu is just okay and I think people will end up doing a lot of settling.
reviews.author: Julie L

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
Located in a hotel which name evokes memories, this is an absolute wonderful treat. Try the charred wings, the salmon and the hanger steak. For dessert just go for the apple crumble and enjoy the sights, the sounds, the view and the extraordinary staff. 
I am sure, all staff is wonderful, but I am glad that we were served and entertained by Samantha
reviews.author: Wolfgang R

reviews.title: Some things are much better than other things
reviews.text: I've been here twice so far. I thought the sandwiches we had at lunch were very good..very above average. We went with two other people. Three out of four of us were very pleased. I thought the salmon was good but they don't give you anything else on the plate so you do need an appetizer. The pheasant tasted good but was a little dry. I heard the mussels were good. Everyone that tried the mushroom flatbread enjoyed it. I heard the meatballs were good too.
reviews.author: TheSaltyPepper

reviews.title: shockingly BAD
reviews.text:
Probably the worst meal I have ever had. Asked for extra lean brisket and got a mountain of fat. Everything is loaded with unnecessary amounts of oil. 
Even with everything being oily and greasy it all tastes bland and bad, Hoping we all don't get sick.
reviews.author: Randy G

reviews.title: Very Fresh, few choices
reviews.text: Mowry and Cotton was inviting.  The plates were packed with fresh ingredients, and on the very healthy side.  Flatbreads were good, but some other items lacked flavor.  Good choice for a quick hotel lunch but not for dinner.
reviews.author: Travelflyhome

reviews.title: Wonderful Experience
reviews.text: What a nice place even for breakfast. Nice and cool in side and outside you overlook the terraced pool area and are southern facing so you can see the broad valley . Them menu is simple but certainly refined. We were waited on “hand and foot” and the food was excellent. I had the avocado toast and a cup of coffee. The seats were comfortable and you never felt rushed.
reviews.author: Lightning077

reviews.title: Good food, lacking service
reviews.text:
Came here for their summer special (3 for 30). Had to wait 10 minutes to be seated even though we had a reservation. Then our server took several minutes to get to us, where we had to ask for a drink menu and a summer special menu, neither of which had been given to us initially.

He finally took our order about 20 minutes after we arrived. Our bread (first course, took another 15 minutes, which wasn't long after the drinks finally arrived. Once the food came it was delicious. The cauliflower side had great flavor. The grilled onion had an excellent sauce with it. The lamb tacos were close to awesome. 

But would I go back? Definitely not. Too many other options out there with better service. The view of the pool is okay, but not worth putting up with the hassle.
reviews.author: Mark

reviews.title: Giving "resort-casual" a bad name.
reviews.text:
First of all, The Phoenician/Mowry & Cotton is in Phoenix NOT Scottsdale which, for me, is a good thing because I reside in downtown Phoenix.  That said, I won't be returning soon, if ever.

On entry, even though they had our reservation via OpenTable making them aware of our request to sit outdoors and that we would be enjoying the Arizona Restaurant Week menu, we were queried as to our seating preference AND seated without the appropriate menus.  This isn't a hUUUge problem but one that should NOT even present itself at a "5-star" resort.  Our server, Nolan and his assistant, Austin, were prompt, capable and responsive.  The restaurant wasn't particularly busy at prime time on Saturday night and it seemed appropriately staffed with team members delivering food from the kitchen as it was ready.

We stuck to the RW menu and were not disappointed.  Chopped salad, charred onions, grilled shrimp and especially the Hanger steak were all excellent.  Timing, temperatures,
presentation and taste couldn't have been better.  We paired our entrees with a reasonably priced AZ Stronghold Syrah that accompanied the bold tastes of our entrees quite nicely.

Chosen desserts included the cornbread pudding with ice cream revealing a spicy character that continued the boldness quotient as well as the lemon meringue tart that proved to be a nice finish to the meal.

If only we were done then...we weren't.

Nolan presented our check and we offered a CC to pay for the meals for four which came to a grand total of $227. including a mandatory 18% gratuity.  To Nolan's credit, upon check presentation, he did alert us to the fact that tip was included but this was the FIRST we were hearing of it...kinda "after the fact"!

Austin returned with the CC and receipt to be totaled and signed.  The amount authorized for CC charge was only $125.  We thought, for one brief moment that somehow, someone (our management visitor to the table, Michelle Gonzales, perhaps?) had gifted us with a discount.  I more or less "dis-counted" THAT idea and tracked down Nolan on my own to inquire about the discrepancy.  He owned-up to the "mistake", re-presented our check explaining that the pre-authorization for $125. would not be charged until and unless it was submitted as a total amount which it hadn't sooo0000, he attempted to pre-authorize the correct amount ($227.) and, OF COURSE (and thankfully), the CC company refused the charge creating a fraud alert.  We received the notice at the table while waiting for Nolan to work though the issue.  What seemed like a VERY long time and after presenting another less preferred form of payment we were finally outta there with barely an apology.

Normally, we would have bumped up the tip to 20% + but, under the circumstances we left the tip line empty knowing he was already receiving 18%.

There were other issues too that should be addressed by M&C management.  The outdoor seating for a meal taking several hours is uncomfortable.  The cushions on the wood seats are not thick or firm enough.  The lighting during the evening was abruptly adjusted in a manner that could not help but be noticed by all and was disconcerting.  If one of the goals at M&C is to attract local fine diners to add to the in-house guests they will have to "up their game" considerably.  Service is a bit too familiar for parties engaged in their meals and conversation and the ambiance is ultra kid/family friendly...not a bad thing generally but, next time I'll think about J&G upstairs or elsewhere entirely.
reviews.author: IvyDad

reviews.title: Mowry & Cotton: the Epicenter of Average
reviews.text:
The Phoenician used to have amazing breakfast, then they switched to Mowry & Cotton.
They tried to be cool and hip, but what they achieved is the definition of average. Food is bland and uninspiring and the service is spotty & slow. You could serve this kind of food in any three star hotels. Disappointing!
The most enjoyable thing every morning was the spectacle of the hawk defending the turf against the annoying desert birds.
reviews.author: Travel Ameniti

reviews.title: Nice place for breakfast
reviews.text: Husband and I were staying at The Phoenician for several days and ate breakfast here three of those days.  The food was consistently good but the service varied.  There is a covered area outside that if you come before it’s too hot is very nice to sit and dine. They have a falcon handler and he comes around with the bird which in turn, keeps the pesky birds away.
reviews.author: Wendy D

reviews.title: Good breakfast
reviews.text: Really enjoyed the breakfast here, but this one place the service wasn't up to par with the other restaurants on the property.  Really saw our wait staff, maybe they were under staffed and because it was breakfast there were lots of people and children running around.  Breakfast was flavorful and good presentation.
reviews.author: LilysMum0723

reviews.title: A+ Family dining
reviews.text:
Mowry & Cotton is a beautiful indoor/outdoor restaurant at The Phoenician resort. 

Seating is very comfortable & the decor is lovely. 

Our family enjoyed the breakfast buffet & also their lunch. 

Service was exceptional from all parties, hostess, server, food server, & bar & kitchen staff. 

The food was delicious & I can’t wait to enjoy the breakfast buffet a few more times before our trip concludes
reviews.author: Cassandra D

reviews.title: Fantastic Chef
reviews.text: We dined at Mowry & Cotton tonight to check out this new Chef, Tandy Peterson and she did not disappoint!  We had the grilled pheasant with cipollini onion, broccolini, almond, citrus and cherry, the roasted salmon with grilled lettuce, pistachio, mustard, olive grapefruit salsa, the harissa braised lamb tacos with Mowry pickles and herb yogurt, the kale and butternut salad with smoked blueberry, Marconi almonds, fennel in a lovely, light Rogue River blue dressing, the BBQ beet salad with mustard greens, toasted chickpeas and smoked onion yogurt, and the Camembert with apple, acrorn squash, sage and watercress purée flatbread followed by the lemon meringue and apple crumble.  Everything was prepared to perfection with unique combinations of flavors that beautifully complemented one another.  Where can you find a menu like this?  The artful presentations added to our delight in this fabulous meal.  We loved the community style offered where we could share the salads and various dishes.  Half the pheasant was plenty for two, or three.  The salmon was grilled perfectly with a crisp skin as delectable as the salmon itself.  The wait staff were knowledgeable, enthusiastic, attentive and charming.  The entire dining experience was perfect and we will definitely make this a repeat performance!
reviews.author: patriciabA2097YB

reviews.title: The breakfast was very good, the lunch looked good but lacked flavor
reviews.text: The breakfast was good, the buffet was basic but fresh and tasty.  Chef ready to make eggs to order.  The lunch we had great presentation but was sort of flavorless.  Pretty disappointing.  The best thing we had was the poached shrimp quinoa salad, that was pretty tasty.
reviews.author: SkiMom33

reviews.title: Scottsdale vacation
reviews.text:
They have a great breakfast buffet for the whole family while staying at the Phoenician!
Wait staff is wonderful and every possible breakfast item is included!
reviews.author: JMG672014

reviews.title: Speed is not the name of the game
reviews.text:
If you’re looking to grab a quick breakfast before heading off to a meeting or for your Arizona adventure, I would suggest finding another restaurant.  

Granted it was a Presidents Day Weekend but it took half an hour to be seated.  Unfortunately the waiter and service echoed the wait for seating.   

Food was good.  Overall experience was not
reviews.author: BL53

reviews.title: Very nice spot for light and creative meals!
reviews.text: Mowry & Cotton is nicely situated just above the pool deck of the resort and offers a pleasant, quiet atmosphere.  Our lunch offered a host of creative options that didn’t disappoint; as a lighter option,  I really enjoyed the seared Ahi tuna lettuce wraps, and my wife found the flatbread very pleasant.  A full bar includes several specialty beers, and even indoor seating is treated to full-glass wall views of the Scottsdale panorama above the pool.
reviews.author: Brian T

reviews.title: Nice eatery with patio
reviews.text: The Mowry & Cotton is a nice eatery set right above the pool. It has an expansive patio where my wife and I sat every morning for breakfast. Many great menu options.
reviews.author: rick c c

reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: We ate here after enjoying drinks and a beautiful sunset on the outdoor terrace.  Incredibly fresh seafood and wonderful beef tenderloin.  Service was very attentive yet not intrusive.  Pricey but well worth the culinary adventure!
reviews.author: SweeneyBoston_Ma

reviews.title: Breakfast @ Mowry & Cotton
reviews.text: Heard a lot about this place, but definitely enjoyed having our Breakfast each day at Mowry & Cotton....the staff were super friendly and yes there was a big selection of breakfast items....reasonably priced considering it was the PHOENICIAN!
reviews.author: Jenette A

reviews.title: Laid back and comfortable but delicious
reviews.text: Newly renovated, Mowry & Cotton is designed for family style meals.  The soup and meatballs were good, but the potatoes, oh the potatoes -- crunchy but light, first baked and then fried, a wonderful cross between potato skins and a perfectly baked potato.  I counted my second helping as my dessert.
reviews.author: Grownup_Traveler

reviews.title: Great spot!
reviews.text: Had a wonderful dinner here in October with a girlfriend. the service was wonderful and the atmosphere was soothing. We sat outside with a view over looking the pool.
reviews.author: Susan A

reviews.title: Exceeded expectations
reviews.text:
I know that some may miss the old, stuffy French that may have preceded M&C in the past, but it is really a good restaurant that fits with what diners expect these days.  Fresh, flavorful and interesting compositions. Many meant to share.  It’s fun. 

Highlights were the scallops, tuna, spare ribs and all the veggies.  Only weak link was the crab app, which although quite tasty, was a very small portion.  Raise the price and increase the portion, or quit offering it.

Desserts were great, especially the s’mores offering. Service was excellent with Tyler and the others on staff.  

Will return for sure.
reviews.author: GianniB

reviews.title: Good food but Hostess/Wait staff we had was rude
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Phoenician at the end of December into the New Year.  The first day we had breakfast here and the hostess said there was a 25 minute wait.  I little while later wile I was sitting on the couch reading the newspaper and I asked one of the waitresses why more people weren't eating from the area outside the lounge and she snapped at me that they would not be able to attend to us properly if we sat out there... 10 minutes later the hostess was seating us in that very area... I then said if we were going to sit there on a cool morning we would appreciate if we could sit by a gas heater.. then she said we were welcomed to go back inside to get in the queue and be re-seated.. After waiting that long to get a second rate seat which they said would not be properly served I wasn't willing to wait any longer and we quickly learned the service was not very good outside.  The food was alright but they brought my daughter the wrong order but made up for it by given her a bowl of fruit.. 

After this experience we decided we would not go there again during our stay at the hotel and glad we didn't as we found several really wonderful restaurants just minutes away that had very original offerings and excellent service.
reviews.author: EGRap

reviews.title: Awesome brunch
reviews.text: The resort is quiet but the Mowry was outstanding.  The pork shank with sunny side up eggs and the crab bruschetta were perfect. Loved the cocktails and the DJ was incredible-old school R&B created a fun atmosphere.
reviews.author: ARAMSP

reviews.title: Not your basic menu
reviews.text: We had dinner while staying at the Phoenician. The menu selections were eclectic, not sure I would call southwest, but you should have a varied palette to enjoy. My husband and I really didn’t care for selections, so one try was it.
reviews.author: Klur56

reviews.title: A Shame
reviews.text: Maybe we are just too old. Maybe too nostalgic for the magnificent Phoenician dining options of the past, Mary Elaine's and the decadent Sunday brunch. We keep going back hoping for a return to quality but no such luck.  Cold things that should have been hot,  indifferent, avoid eye contact service, dry meat on a charcuterie board, over cooked eggs Benedict on under toasted English muffin yuk. Had to walk up and ask the hostess for our bill. Basically a mess.
reviews.author: Mary M

reviews.title: Great for Relaxing Dining
reviews.text: The Breakfast Buffet is outstanding. Excellent options for family dining at lunch and dinner. Complimentary flatbread with an entree.
reviews.author: Ansel C

reviews.title: You should go.
reviews.text: This place was awesome. Zoe our server was perfect- knew alot about the food and helped us decide. They seated us outside by the heat lamps. Food looked and tasted unique. Great flavours. Great timing. Highly recommend, I don't think you will be disappointed.
reviews.author: travelingpants2016

reviews.title: The perfect combination
reviews.text:
It is well known that locals rarely eat in local hotel restaurants, not least because they are perceived as being more expensive than the average venue.
The prestigious Phoenician Hotel have opened their newest restaurant, Mowry and Cotton. The aim has been to create a friendly dining  experience with dishes to be shared at  reasonable prices and they certainly have succeeded.
I was skeptical when I first read the menu that the food would not appeal but let me assure you, it is of a standard and taste rarely achieved. 
On my first visit I ordered more dishes than normal. Each one was beautifully presented, perfectly seasoned and a delight on the taste buds.
The service was excellent and our waiter, Tyler, was able to explain all the dishes in detail. This is important because the dishes have unusual combinations and unlike most restaurants there is no set serving of appetizers and main dishes. They arrive from the kitchen one after the other and are placed on the table for all to share.
It is difficult to categories the style because it is so innovative. Probably Southwestern with a difference.
Every dish was delicious and all were exceptional. Just to mention three that were outstanding are Crispy Potatoes (the crispiest ever) $11. The whole Pacific Stripped Bass roasted in the grill with sweet corn. The fish is large enough for four to share and it is served to make your own tortillas $38. Finally out of a delicious small dessert menu the Apple Crumble was made with the most toffee like 
crumble $9.
The wine list is adequate and interesting for all tastes and is most reasonably priced for a five star hotel. But then all prices  are exceptional  for such a venue with its outside patio overlooking the discreetly lit pool area and the twinkling lights of Phoenix in the far distance
Executive head chef Rick Boyer and chef in charge Tandy Petersen have created a gem of a restaurant and locals would be well advised to at least try it. It will not be to everyone's taste but then no restaurant ever is. But if you don't give it a try you will never know what you are missing.
In my opinion great food, super ambiance, efficient service and value for money. The perfect combination.
reviews.author: MARKER2727

reviews.title: Superb Casual Luxury
reviews.text:
I dined with my friends in November and everything about the experience was incredible. 

Set in a rustic, modern environment with jugs lined on the walls and leather accents everywhere, the new hotel full service restaurant creates a wonderful luxurious Southwestern saloon.

The cocktails all were tasty. The Boss may have been my favorite, but it's tough to choose from the wide selection. My friends and I did not know what to order, so we essentially ordered one of everything. Our server notified us that the dishes were meant to be shared, and shared they were! While the menu does not have a specific appetizer and entrée section, we made due with our options. The bass and ribs were to die for. The bass was a perfect blend of so many flavors that were hard to distinguish between the smoky, lemony bites. The ribs fell right off the bone. The bison carpaccio, a true table favorite, disappeared within a minute.

A true communal experience with a wonderful Arizona atmosphere, this restaurant is a fine addition to the New Phoenician Resort. It was much needed as the old restaurant felt 20 years in the past. This one feels like it is marching toward the future with nostalgic glances back to Phoenix's luxury dining past. I cannot wait to go back!
reviews.author: Henri

reviews.title: Nice upscale restaurant
reviews.text:
For a hotel main restaurant, this is pretty upscale dining-- locally sourced, innovative combinations, cooked perfectly with friendly knowledgeable service !!

It has a very casual atmosphere overlooking the hotel's three pools.There is both indoor and outdoor dining. Outdoors is particularly nice in the evenings.

We had dinner here twice all items we ordered were enjoyable. We had charred Brussels sprouts which were very flavorful, smoked brisket soup which was excellent, veal and black garlic meatballs which were soft and packed with flavors, chicken thin crusted flatbread with a perfect mixture of fennel and kale, delicious and perfectly cooked herrissa flavored  lamb tacos  with perfect garnishes, and charred hanger steak with chantrelles and sunflower pesto.

It should be clear that we had quite a sampling of a wide variety of dishes.All were excellent !

Would definitely return here!!
reviews.author: 416edb

reviews.title: Excellent food and service
reviews.text: My husband and I visited for dinner and took advantage of all the small portions.  The food was fantastic, especially (surprisingly) the beets and the tuna.  Also, the key lime, instead of being an insipid afterthought, was hands down the very best I have had anywhere.  Save room for a piece.  The ambience and service also were excellent.
reviews.author: bnmlaw

reviews.title: Wonderful Dinner!
reviews.text: We had an amazing meal and were consistently blown away by each plate that came out. Service was perfect and the desserts are to die for!
reviews.author: Casey E

reviews.title: Fantastic Dinner
reviews.text: My wife and I took my parents there for dinner. We sat on the lovely patio and had an absolutely fabulous dinner.
reviews.author: Dale M

reviews.title: Delicious Lunch with Pool View
reviews.text:
Mowry & Cotton is located in the The Phoenician. We missed breakfast, but decided to check it out for lunch.

Quickly seated outside, with a great view of the pool. Most of the outside seating has some sort of covered ceiling, and umbrellas for added shade. Service was quick, ordered an orange juice and some waters. We thought we would try a couple of dishes and settled on the Lamb Tacos, Wild Mushroom Flatbread and Poached Shrimp & Quinoa bowl. These were recommended by our server who was trying to avoid dairy in our dishes.

Lamb Tacos - 3 mini tacos - and I mean mini. It's probably good for one person, since we ordered a couple of dishes it worked out well. The tacos are first glance, your like okay, how good could they be...and yup they are real damn good. Lamb so delicious and juicy, probably could of had a plate of the lamb on its on. The pickles were a nice touch. Very very good.

Wild Mushroom Flatbread - no cheese on our order, but they used olive oil and garlic instead. Very nice, the mix of mushrooms and the flavours worked real well.

Poached Shrimp & Quinoa bowl - how could a healthy bowl be? Real real good - the flavours go together so well. The shrimp was fresh and to tender. Who knew.

Great lunch experience - will have to try dinner sometime this week. I would recommend this restaurant. Attention to detail and service outstanding. 

Oh and they brought a hawk by a couple times - thought they were going to put a on a show lol, but its really just to keep the bird away.
reviews.author: stunt101
